title: Content Coordinator & Short-Form Video Editor
description:
**Part-Time Content Coordinator & Video Editor — Potential for Full-Time**



We’re an American-led sourcing and supply business based in Guangzhou, China, working across three brands: Customise, Crew Stock, and ZA.



We’re looking for a self-sufficient content coordinator who can research topics, plan shoots, edit videos, and schedule approved content across Instagram,
, TikTok, and YouTube.



**Hours & compensation**



- Approximately 20 hours per week initially.

- Budget: $450–$550 USD per month, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.

- Potential to grow into a full-time position based on performance and business needs.

- Some working-hour overlap with our Guangzhou team is required. The Philippines and Guangzhou share the same time zone.



**What you’ll do**



- Research our products, customers, competitors, and relevant content trends.

- Develop video ideas, hooks, talking points, and clear calls to action.

- Prepare simple scripts and shot lists for our founder and anyone helping film.

- Coordinate with Bella, our China-based sourcing and operations colleague, to identify which factories, showrooms, products, or locations we need to visit.

- Communicate filming requirements ahead of visits and follow up on missing footage.

- Edit factory walkthroughs, product demonstrations, and founder footage into engaging short-form videos.

- Add accurate subtitles, suitable music, graphics, and cover images.

- Write captions and adapt content for each platform.

- Maintain a content calendar and organized footage library.

- Upload content to a scheduling platform, submit it for approval, and schedule approved posts.

- Prepare story content and recommend relevant posts for us to share.

- Review content performance and recommend improvements.



**Who we’re looking for**



You take ownership of the process. You bring ideas, explain what footage you need, coordinate with the team, and keep work moving without waiting for daily instructions.



You should have:



- Strong written and spoken English.

- A portfolio of short-form videos you personally edited.

- Experience with content planning, hooks, scripts, and shot lists.

- Proficiency with CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or a comparable tool.

- Familiarity with social media scheduling platforms.

- Confidence using AI tools for research, brainstorming, and drafting, with your own judgment and accuracy checks.

- Reliable internet, a suitable editing computer, and strong organizational skills.



Experience with B2B marketing, manufacturing, sourcing, or physical products is a plus.



All content requires our approval before publishing.



**How to apply**



Use the subject line: **CONTENT COORDINATOR — [Your Name]**



Please include:



1. A short introduction and your relevant experience.

2. Three videos you personally edited, explaining your contribution.

3. Two content ideas for a China-based business selling custom packaging to established retailers. Include the hook and footage you would request.

4. How many original short-form videos you could realistically plan, edit, and prepare for publishing within 20 hours per week, while also handling the coordination and scheduling responsibilities above. Explain your assumptions about video length, editing complexity, and supplied footage.

5. The editing, scheduling, and AI tools you use.

6. Your expected monthly compensation, availability, and earliest start date.

7. Whether you would be interested in moving into a full-time role later.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small paid practical task.

title: Permitting Coordinator
description:
Permitting Coordinator (Remote, Philippines-Based)

Coharbor Electric LLC | 20 hours a week--with potential to grow as we grow | US Eastern Business Hours

 

About Coharbor Electric



Coharbor Electric is a licensed residential and commercial electrical contractor serving southwest Florida. We handle everything from residential service and repairs to commercial electrical work, generator installations, commercial maintenance, and permanent smart lighting.

 

Our mission is simple: high-quality electrical work done with integrity. We’re built on integrity, accountability, veteran leadership, faith-based leadership, and teamwork.

 

You’ll be joining a growing team that already includes five Philippines-based teammates who work closely with our Florida office every day.

 

About the Role



The Permitting Coordinator owns the full permit lifecycle for Coharbor jobs across Lee County, Collier County, Sarasota County and the cities within them. You’re the link between our project managers, field techs, customers, and the building departments. You make sure every job is permitted correctly, inspected on time, and closed out on record. You will set up the disconnect and reconnect power coordinating with the Install Manager. 

 

A permit left open after the job is done is unfinished business. It becomes a compliance problem for us and a property-record problem for the customer. The right person for this role doesn’t let that happen.



Key Responsibilities



Permit Applications

Identify the correct permitting authority for each job address, including city versus unincorporated county.

Assemble complete permit packets, including scope of work, load calculations and drawings where required, contractor license details, certificates of insurance, and Notices of Commencement.

Submit applications through each jurisdiction’s online portal or intake process.

Follow up on stalled applications, respond to plan reviewer comments, and handle corrections and resubmittals.



Tracking, Inspections & Close-Out

Maintain a permit tracker showing every open permit’s status, dates, fees, and next action at a glance.

Schedule and confirm inspections, and coordinate with techs so the site is ready.

Track failed inspections through to a passed re-inspection, routing correction notices to the right person.

Make sure no permit expires while a job is open, and close out every permit with a passed final.

Resolve expired permits by reapplying, clearing fees, and scheduling follow-up inspections.



Liaison & Communication

Act as the main point of contact between building departments and our internal team on permit matters.

Call and
 building departments during Florida business hours.

Give project managers and customers clear, timely permit status updates.

Escalate blockers early and in writing, stating what’s needed and from whom.



Compliance & Records

Review scopes before submission and flag anything that won’t pass review as written.

Build and maintain a reference library of each jurisdiction’s requirements, fees, and inspection procedures.

Verify that licenses and insurance certificates are current before they go on an application.

Track permit fees and keep records organized so anyone on the team can find a job’s status without asking.



Required Qualifications

Hands-on permit coordination or regulatory compliance experience, meaning you personally prepared and submitted applications.

Ability to manage many open items and deadlines at once without losing the quiet ones.

Strong Excel skills: you build your own trackers with filters, sorting, and formulas.

Confident spoken and written English, and you’re comfortable making several outbound calls a day to US government offices.

Exceptional attention to detail. A wrong address or an expired certificate means a rejected application and a crew standing still.

Takes correction as information, not criticism.

Reliable high-speed internet, a headset, and a quiet workspace.

Available to work US Eastern business hours (night shift in the Philippines).



Preferred Qualifications

USA permitting experience

Electrical or construction trade background.

Experience with permit portals such as Accela, EnerGov, or similar.

2+ years of construction-related office work.



Tools You’ll Use

ServiceTitan, Microsoft 365 (Excel, Outlook, Word, Teams, SharePoint), and county and city permit portals.



What Makes You a Great Fit

You keep working the tail of the list until every permit is closed.

You don’t guess at a rule you don’t know. You find out who to ask, ask clearly, and write the answer down for the next person.

You flag problems while they’re small, without being asked.

You keep a system, not a memory.

You’re steady. You build a routine on a US schedule and hold it.



What We Offer

100% remote, full-time

A stable, growing team with five Philippines-based teammates already on board

title: Part-Time B2B Sales Outreach & Lead Qualification Representative — US Hours
description:
**Part-Time B2B Sales Outreach & Lead Qualification Representative — US Hours**



**Location:** Remote  

**Pay:** $6–$7 USD/hour, depending on experience, plus performance bonuses  

**Hours:** 27 hours per week  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9 AM–2 PM US Eastern; Saturday, 10 AM–12 PM US Eastern  

**Start:** Paid 30-day trial, with the goal of a long-term role



**About us**



Customise helps established businesses source custom packaging, retail supplies, and branded products through our China-based sourcing team and factory partners.



We’re looking for a proactive sales representative who can find suitable business customers, start conversations, respond to inquiries, and collect requirements for our sourcing team to prepare quotes.



This role combines outbound prospecting with inbound lead handling. You must be comfortable making live calls to US businesses.



**Responsibilities**



- Research potential customers through Instagram, business websites, and other relevant sources.

- Review videos and accounts we provide, identify suitable business buyers, and find additional prospects independently.

- Make outbound calls and send personalized outreach through approved channels.

- Answer incoming calls and messages promptly during your shift.

- Follow up with interested prospects, previous inquiries, and outstanding quotes.

- Collect product specifications, quantities, delivery location, timeline, and artwork status.

- Qualify prospects against our minimum order requirements.

- Maintain accurate contact records, conversation notes, and follow-up tasks in GoHighLevel.

- Coordinate with our sourcing team and keep customers informed.

- Submit a brief daily report covering activity, qualified opportunities, and next steps.



Saturday hours will primarily focus on incoming inquiries and follow-ups. Our sourcing team handles supplier research and final pricing; you must not make unapproved pricing or delivery promises.



**Requirements**



- At least one year of relevant B2B sales, outbound calling, appointment-setting, or lead-qualification experience.

- Clear, easily understood spoken English and strong written English.

- Confidence speaking with US business owners and handling objections.

- A natural, conversational communication style.

- Strong research skills and good judgment about which businesses are suitable prospects.

- Experience using a CRM and maintaining organized follow-ups.

- Reliable availability for the full schedule, including Saturdays.

- Quiet workspace, quality headset, stable internet, and a practical backup connectivity/power plan.

- Respect for customer confidentiality and company account security.



GoHighLevel experience is preferred. Packaging, sourcing, manufacturing, or retail experience is a plus.



**Schedule details**



The schedule follows US Eastern time and changes with US daylight saving time.



For applicants in the Philippines:



- **US standard time:** Monday–Friday, 10 PM–3 AM the following day; Saturday, 11 PM–1 AM the following day.

- **US daylight saving time:** Monday–Friday, 9 PM–2 AM the following day; Saturday, 10 PM–12 midnight.



**Performance bonuses**



In addition to hourly pay:



- **$10 per new qualified opportunity** accepted by our sourcing team.

- **An additional $50** when that prospect’s first order of at least **$2,000 USD** is paid in full.



A qualified opportunity must be a genuine business buyer who meets our minimum order requirement, provides the necessary buying information, and requests a quote. Unanswered outreach, duplicate contacts, and existing inquiries do not qualify for the new-opportunity bonus.



Detailed qualification, attribution, and bonus payment terms will be agreed before starting.



**How to apply**



Please include:



1. Your résumé and a short description of your relevant B2B sales experience.

2. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining how you would approach a retail store about custom packaging.

3. A brief example of how you handled the objection: “We already have a supplier.”

4. The CRM and calling tools you have used.

5. Your location, requested hourly rate, earliest start date, and confirmation that you can consistently work the stated schedule.

6. A brief description of your workspace and backup internet/power arrangements.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a live mock call and a short paid research and CRM exercise.

title: CEO MUM Podcast — Video Editor
description:
CEO MUM is looking for an experienced freelance Podcast Video Editor for our upcoming 10-episode season, with the potential for ongoing work afterwards.



CEO MUM, hosted by Jada Sezer, is an interview-led video podcast about motherhood, ambition, careers and entrepreneurship, for ambitious women expecting or raising young children. Our message: Become a mother. Keep building.



You'll take each recording through the complete post-production process: the long-form video episode, professionally mastered audio, a trailer, social clips, and thumbnails and covers.



We want an all-rounder, but three skills come first:



1. Editing. You can shape a 60-minute, two-camera conversation into a tight, story-led episode of about 40 minutes, with clips that stop the scroll.



2. Sound. You can deliver a finished, professional podcast audio master: clean, warm, balanced and mastered to spec. This is essential, not a bonus.



3. Colour grade. You can make every frame look bright, clean and premium, with two cameras matched and skin that looks natural and luminous. This is essential too.





We know few editors are equally strong at everything. When you apply, you'll rate yourself in each area and tell us your strongest and weakest skills. If design (thumbnails, Reel covers) isn't your strength, that's fine: we can give that part to someone else.



The look is Vogue: sophisticated, editorial, bright and clean. The pace is Hot Smart Rich podcast: light, commercial and easy to listen to while driving, doing your make-up or pushing a buggy. 





WHAT YOU'LL RECEIVE FOR EACH EPISODE



Everything is shared through 
. We will give you a brief with transcript notes, you won't build the editorial structure from scratch, but we want your creative eye to improve the pacing and spot extra moments that could do well on social.



- Raw interview footage: two camera angles and separate host and guest audio tracks (about 60 minutes)

- A full transcript with timestamps

- Jada's edit notes: running order, planned cuts, chapter structure, suggested social moments with timecodes, and any sensitive sections that must stay long-form only or never be clipped

- Jada's trailer intro (one continuous piece to camera) and the key moments to cut into it

- The CEO MUM CTA outro (video and audio), reused every episode

- Music: the "Only Gold Rings" jingle and stems (licensed)

- The editor library in 
 > ASSETS: fonts, logos, music licence, white studio thumbnail background and templates

- The full Editor's Brief, with running orders, specs and examples





1. EDITING (TOP PRIORITY)



The full episode (16:9)

- Cut about 60 minutes down to about 40 minutes, never more than 50

- Multi-camera edit: sync the separate audio tracks and both cameras

- Restructure the story: open on the strongest moment, then tell the guest's story in order. The order of the interview is never the order of the edit

- After Jada signs off in 
, export two versions: Spotify (CEO MUM watermark top right) and YouTube (completely clean)



The trailer

- 30–60 seconds, every episode: Jada's intro cut at natural pauses, with interview moments dropped in, ending on the strongest line.

- Delivered at 16:9 (opens the full episode) and 9:16 (Clip 01 on social, with the CEO MUM logo and subtitles)



Social clips (9:16, for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts)

- 10 clips per episode: the trailer clip plus 9 key moments. Length depends on the moment, usually 30–90 seconds



- Subtitles: phrase by phrase (2–4 words), sentence case, medium weight, white on a soft dark backing, lower third, inside the safe zone and clear of faces. Every word checked against the audio, names spelt correctly





2. SOUND (ESSENTIAL)



Sound is one of our three priorities, and we'll test it closely on the trial. Please only apply if you're confident producing a finished professional podcast audio master, not just adjusting volume levels.





3. COLOUR GRADE AND SKIN (ESSENTIAL)



The grade is a big part of the CEO MUM look, and we'll judge it as closely as the edit and the sound. We need someone with real colour grading skills, not someone who only applies a preset or LUT.







4. THUMBNAILS AND COVERS (WANTED, BUT CAN GO TO SOMEONE ELSE)



Tell us honestly how strong you are here and send examples. If design isn't your strength, we can give this part to someone else.



- YouTube thumbnails

- Instagram Reel covers





THE EDITING STYLE



CEO MUM is conversational, premium, warm and honest. We want the pace of a strong modern interview podcast: engaging and tight, without feeling over-edited.





Hard no's: manufactured controversy or misleading edits, generic clickbait headlines, the spoken guest welcome at the start, constant zooms or jump cuts, meme sounds or swooshes, trend effects, emojis on screen, heavy-outline or all-caps subtitles, the spinning logo animation, stock footage or B-roll (unless Jada supplies it), and unlicensed music, fonts or stock.



We write the social captions, show notes and publishing copy. 



Your main job is excellent video and audio.



ATTENTION TO DETAIL: to show you've read the whole ad, put the word EDITOR in the subject line of your application. We may not review applications without it.





WHAT YOU DELIVER PER EPISODE



- Full episode with watermark (Spotify): MP4 16:9, 1920x1080, end card on

- Full episode, clean (YouTube): MP4 16:9, 1920x1080, end card on

- Trailer: 30 seconds MP4 16:9 and 9:16

- 10 clips with copy (logo + subtitles): MP4 9:16, 1080x
clips, completely clean: MP4 9:16, 1080x1920

- Audio episode: WAV 48 kHz 24-bit master + MP3 (192 kbps or higher)

- 3 YouTube thumbnail options: JPG/PNG 1280x720, under 2 MB

- 10 Instagram Reel covers: PNG 1080x1920



Video: H.264, frame rate matched to the camera, AAC audio at 48 kHz. 





WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Essential

- Professional experience editing podcasts or long-form interviews

- Multi-camera video editing

- Strong audio cleanup, mixing and mastering

- Strong colour correction, grading and camera matching, with natural skin retouching

- High-quality Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts, with clean subtitles and on-screen text

- A good understanding of pacing, storytelling and audience retention

- The ability to follow transcript-based edit notes accurately

- Fluent written English and excellent attention to detail

- Reliable communication and deadlines

- Good headphones or studio monitors, and internet fast enough for large files (episodes can be 5 GB or more)



Useful tools include Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, Adobe Audition, Fairlight, Auphonic and iZotope RX, or equivalents.



Nice to have

- Motion graphics (After Effects or similar)

- Thumbnail and cover design (Photoshop, Canva or similar)

- Experience with women's, lifestyle, parenting or business content

- A strong instinct for social media moments

- 
 or a similar review platform

- Uploading drafts to YouTube, podcast hosts or scheduling tools





WORKING ARRANGEMENT



- Remote and freelance, paid per completed episode package (not hourly)

- The upcoming season has 10 episodes, roughly two a month. This isn't guaranteed and depends on our recording schedule

- Paid trial: we'll choose one editor to edit one full episode to the complete brief, paid at the same rate as ongoing work

HOW TO APPLY

4. Design (if you do it): examples of thumbnails or Reel covers

5. Your experience: where you're based and your time zone, how many years you've professionally edited podcasts, and the software you use for video editing, colour grading, and audio cleanup, mixing and mastering

6. Your self-rating: rate yourself from 1 (beginner) to 5 (expert) in each area below, then tell us your two strongest and two weakest areas. Honesty helps: if design isn't your thing, we can give it to someone else

   - Intro animation and motion graphics: _/5

   - YouTube thumbnails: _/5

   - Instagram Reel covers: _/5

   - Uploading to YouTube, podcast hosts or schedulers: _/5



7. Your rate, in USD: a fixed rate for:

1 x Episode package (long-form video in both versions, 

1 x mixed and mastered audio

1 x edited trailer

9 x clips for social media 

3 x thumbnail cover for YouTube 

10 x covers for Instagram 

 2–3 revision rounds

 2–3 revision rounds

title: Experienced Bookkeeper
description:
Company Overview

We are a small, growing accounting and business services firm based in Coulsdon, UK. We support clients with bookkeeping, accounting and financial compliance, alongside outsourced business administration and process management services. Our focus is on building long-term client relationships and delivering a consistently high standard of service.



Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced bookkeeper based in the Philippines to support our team with ongoing client bookkeeping and the preparation of accounts up to year-end review stage.

We need someone who can independently manage bookkeeping for multiple clients, investigate discrepancies and prepare accurate accounts and supporting working papers for review by our accountant.

The role will also involve coordinating client work, support other bookkeeping colleagues and help improve our processes.



Role Objectives

• Ensure allocated client accounts are accurate, fully reconciled and completed within agreed deadlines.

• Prepare client records and supporting schedules ready for year-end accounts preparation.

• Keep clients and the Business Manager informed of progress, outstanding information and any issues requiring attention.

• Help maintain clear, consistent bookkeeping procedures and identify opportunities to improve efficiency.

• Support the quality and timely completion of work undertaken by junior bookkeeping colleagues.



Key Responsibilities

• Maintaining accurate client records in Xero and QuickBooks Online, including sales invoices, purchase invoices, expenses and receipts.

• Reconciling bank accounts, credit cards and payment platforms, including multi-currency transactions where applicable.

• Reviewing sales and purchase ledgers, allocating payments, investigating outstanding balances and supporting credit control where required.

• Reconciling accounting records against booking systems, spreadsheets and other client records to identify missing or incorrect entries.

• Reconciling balance sheet accounts, including VAT, payroll liabilities, loans and directors’ loan accounts.

• Preparing and posting journals, including payroll, accruals, prepayments and depreciation, with supporting calculations.

• Preparing VAT workings and draft returns for review.

• Reviewing profit and loss reports and balance sheets, investigating unusual transactions and discussing potential errors with the Business Manager.

• Preparing a fully reconciled trial balance, year-end schedules and supporting working papers for the accountant’s review.

• Preparing regular reconciliation reports and supporting monthly financial reporting, including budget comparisons where required.

• Following up on missing information and keeping clients informed of queries and progress.

• Planning and tracking allocated client work in line with agreed workflows and deadlines.

• Creating and updating client-specific standard operating procedures (SOPs), including documenting recurring tasks and reviewing procedures when requirements change.

• Identifying process issues and suggesting practical improvements to reduce errors and save time.

• Supporting junior bookkeepers by reviewing assigned tasks, answering routine queries and sharing process guidance.

• Assisting with client onboarding and occasional finance-related administrative tasks as required.



Key Skills / Capabilities / Behaviours

• Proven experience managing bookkeeping for multiple clients, ideally within an accountancy practice.

• Experience working with UK client accounts and a good understanding of UK bookkeeping and VAT.

• Demonstrated ability to prepare accounts through to trial balance and year-end review stage.

• Strong practical knowledge of Xero and/or QuickBooks Online.

• A sound understanding of double-entry bookkeeping, journals and balance sheet reconciliations.

• Excellent reconciliation skills and the ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies.

• Confident Excel skills, including lookup formulas, SUMIF/SUMIFS, filters and pivot tables.

• Excellent attention to detail and a consistent approach to checking work.

• Good written and spoken English, with the ability to explain queries clearly to clients and colleagues.

• Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage deadlines across several client accounts.

• Ability to learn client systems quickly and document processes clearly.

• Confidence working independently, using initiative and recognising when an issue requires the accountant’s input.

• A supportive, collaborative approach and willingness to help colleagues develop their skills.

• A professional approach to handling confidential client information.



Hours and Location

Hours of work: 8 hours per day, Monday to Friday

Location: Remote, Philippines.

You will need a reliable internet connection, a suitable computer and a quiet working environment.



Rate of Pay - negotiable based on experience

 



We also offer:

• Annual bonus based on personal and company performance 

• Contractors and team members are advised to keep 1-1 notes of progress and deliveries







Work requirements

• Good quality PC with 16GB ram 

• Two screens 1920x1080 (required for our inhouse systems)

• Headset

• Video camera – high resolution

title: Executive Assistant to CEO—-Electrical Contractor
description:
Executive Assistant to CEO— Electrical Contractor, USA



Company: Coharbor Electric LLC — Cape Coral / Fort Myers, Florida (USA)

Schedule: Full-time, 40 hrs/week, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern Time (you must work USA business hours)

Location: 100% Remote — Philippines-based

Compensation: Depending on experience. Paid via Wise. Long-term, full-time role with room to grow as we double.

Start: As soon as we find the right person.





Who We Are



Coharbor Electric is a veteran-owned, Christian-owned residential and commercial electrical contractor serving Southwest Florida since 2010. We were founded by our CEO, Jacob Anderson — a Major in the U.S. Air Force — and we are a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Business. We do service work, panel and service changes, generator and EV-charger installs, new construction, and larger commercial projects including fire stations.



Our mission is simple and we mean it: "To provide high quality electrical work, on time, with integrity. Our purpose is to empower and lift up our employees, customers, partners, and fellow community members." We treat our customers the way we'd treat our own family, we use honest flat-rate pricing with no upsell scripts, and we live by a verse we keep in front of us: "Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord" (Colossians 3:23). We say we're "bringing light to a dark world," and we mean that about more than wiring.



That value — to empower and lift up our employees — is why this role exists. We are a team of about 20, and we intend to double. The thing slowing us down isn't demand; it's that too much runs through one desk. We're hiring a Chief of Staff to change that. Of our team of 20, we do have 5 employees in PH already. 



This is not a "send me tasks and I'll do them" job. This is a build-and-own job. We have a list of programs we've wanted to launch for a while and haven't had the bandwidth to build. Your job is to take them off the CEO's plate, build them, run them, and keep them running — and to organize the back office so leadership can stop living in the inbox.



If you want to be told exactly what to do every hour, this is the wrong role. If you see a mess and instinctively build the system that fixes it — and you want to work for a company whose word actually means something — keep reading.





What You'll Own



1. Inbox & Communication (the CEO should rarely touch email)





Take full ownership of the CEO's email inbox: triage, organize, label/folder, and clear it out.

Build a daily system: what needs the CEO, what you've handled, what's FYI.

Over your first 60–90 days, earn the trust to draft and then send routine replies on the CEO's behalf, reporting back in a single daily summary. The goal is simple: the CEO stops checking email.





2. Microsoft Teams — Organize It





Restructure Microsoft Teams: channels, files, naming conventions, and folder logic so the whole company can find what it needs.

Keep it organized as we grow.





3. Launch & Run Operational Programs (the core of this role)

You will build these from the ground up, document them, and then run them:





Installer Bonus Program — design and administer a performance bonus structure for our install crews.

Weekly Sales Tech Commissions — calculate and run sales technician commissions every week, accurately and on time.

Commercial Service Program — help stand up a recurring commercial service offering: the process, the workflow, the follow-up system.





4. Own the Hiring, Onboarding & Offboarding Process

We are doubling — you keep hiring organized and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. The CEO and our Technical Managers scan resumes and run the interviews; you own everything around that:





Post the jobs — write and publish job postings for open roles.

Schedule interviews — coordinate calendars and set up interviews between candidates and the CEO / Technical Managers.

Onboarding — once a candidate is hired, ensure 100% of onboarding paperwork is completed correctly and on time, and run them through the onboarding process.

Offboarding — when an employee parts ways, complete the offboarding paperwork and process accurately and discreetly.

Build and maintain the checklists and document templates that make onboarding and offboarding repeatable every single time.





5. Build Our Operating System (SOPs & Documentation)





Create SOPs, process documentation, templates, and operational systems — and do it for an electrical contracting business, where the details matter.

Turn "how we do things" out of the CEO's head and into written, repeatable systems.





6. Personal Assistant Support for the CEO

This role also supports the CEO personally. You will:





Book personal and business appointments and manage the CEO's calendar.

Set up and coordinate returns to retailers (initiate returns, schedule pickups, track refunds).

Categorize personal and family expenses and help maintain the family budget.

Handle other personal-assistant tasks as they come up — this person is a trusted right hand in both business and personal logistics.







What We Need From You



Required





3+ years supporting a CEO, founder, or executive as a Chief of Staff or high-level Executive Assistant — not a general/entry-level VA role.

Proven track record building systems, SOPs, and processes from scratch — please be ready to show examples of operational systems you have built.

Strong, professional written and spoken English. You will communicate on the CEO's behalf.

Comfort with numbers: you will run weekly commissions and a bonus program. Accuracy is non-negotiable.

Highly organized, proactive, and able to make sound decisions without being told.

Trustworthy and discreet — you will handle sensitive financial and personnel information.

Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional remote setup.

Able and willing to work USA Eastern business hours, full-time.





A Strong Plus (not required)





Experience with ServiceTitan and/or QuickBooks.

Experience supporting a trades, construction, electrical, HVAC, or home-services company.

HR, recruiting coordination, or employee onboarding/offboarding experience.

Comfort using AI tools to work faster.







How We Work



We are direct, we move fast, and we value people who take ownership and tell us the truth — including when we're wrong. As a faith-driven, veteran-owned company, integrity matters more to us than anything on your resume. You will handle sensitive financial and personnel information and represent the CEO in writing, so trustworthiness isn't a nice-to-have here — it's the whole job. We measure this role on outcomes: programs launched, inbox controlled, systems built. Do that well and this role grows with the company as we double.





How to Apply



To prove you actually read this posting, start your application with the phrase: "Built to last." Applications without it will not be read.



Please send:





A short introduction telling us about a system, SOP, or program you personally built for a previous employer — what was broken, what you built, and the result.

Your resume.

Your desired monthly rate in USD.

Your earliest available start date.

One sentence on why a remote role on US Eastern hours works for you long-term.





We review every complete application. We look forward to meeting you.

title: Store Manager
description:
ABOUT US



Rueger Rose is our Scandinavian jewelry brand: handcrafted, 100% waterproof gold and silver jewelry, made to be worn every day, in the shower and in the sea.



We sell on 
 across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, the UK and Finland. We launch new products every week and test them fast.



The store needs one person who owns it day to day and keeps it running smoothly, so the brand team can focus on ads and growth.



You are hired by Vaunt Partners and placed on Rueger Rose. You start hands-on, doing the work yourself. As the store scales, you will help hire and train the people who take tasks off your plate.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



THE ROLE



You own the Rueger Rose store. That means:



✔ Every product is listed properly, looks right and is live where it should be.

✔ When something needs to change, you spot it, raise it and get it done.

✔ Nothing slips through the cracks.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



WHAT YOU WILL DO



▸ PRODUCT LISTINGS



• List new jewelry on Shopify:

   - photos, titles, descriptions, details, care guides, materials and sizes

   - prices and variants per metal (gold, silver, rose gold)

   - collections and Swedish, Danish and Norwegian translations

   - publishing to every sales channel

• Keep every product's status up to date in our Notion product database, from "Want To Test" to "Listed".

• Find winning products: study what scaling jewelry brands run in the Meta Ad Library and Foreplay, then find the same piece on Alibaba.

• Check every product before it goes live. It must be waterproof and tarnish-free (stainless steel, no copper, brass or pearl), and the materials, plating and sizes must match the listing.

• Fill in product data and specs, and flag anything unclear to the supplier.

• Run product photo shoots with Claude and Kive (our AI image tool), and check every image against the real product:

   - same model, one outfit per product

   - true scale on the body and the right stone count

   - "close" is not good enough

• Keep images and assets organised in 
.



▸ WEBSITE HEALTH



• Check 
 every day in every market: product pages, collections, cart, checkout, the buy 1 get 1 free offer, discounts, mobile and desktop.

• Catch broken links, wrong prices, missing images, out-of-date offers and translation errors before customers do.

• Test new theme changes and offers before they go live.



▸ CHANGES AND IMPROVEMENTS



• Keep a running list of what needs to change on the store and why.

• Raise issues and suggestions to the brand lead, with screenshots and a clear fix.

• Make the changes you can make yourself (content, listings, collections, settings) and follow up on the rest until they are done.



▸ KEEPING THINGS RUNNING



• Keep the store tidy:

   - collections (necklaces, bracelets, rings, earrings, Birthstone Collection, Gold Edit, Silver Edit, New In)

   - tags, filters and product order

   - sold-out and dropped products

• Keep processes and checklists up to date so anyone can follow them.



▸ LATER: BUILDING THE TEAM



• As the store grows, help recruit, onboard and train people to take over your tasks.

• Turn what you do into simple processes others can follow.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



WHAT YOU BRING



▸ MUST HAVE



• Experience working on Shopify stores for DTC brands. You have listed products, managed collections and fixed store issues before.

• Very comfortable in the Shopify admin:

   - products, variants, collections and metafields

   - markets, translations and discounts

   - themes (enough to test and spot problems)

• You use AI tools every day, especially Claude. You give clear instructions and check the output.

• You learn new tools fast: Notion, 
, Kive, ad libraries and Alibaba.

• Experience finding products and suppliers on Alibaba or similar, and judging quality and materials from a listing.

• An eye for detail. You notice a wrong price, a blurry photo, an extra stone or a broken link straight away.

• Organised and reliable. You keep track of many listings without being chased.

• Clear written English.



▸ NICE TO HAVE



• Experience with jewelry or fashion accessories brands.

• Swedish, Danish or Norwegian, for checking translations.

• Basic knowledge of Liquid or theme editing.

• Experience with Meta ads, product testing or running a store end to end.

• Experience hiring or training others.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



TOOLS YOU WILL USE



Shopify • Claude (Claude Code and claude.ai) • Notion • 
 • Kive • Alibaba • Meta Ad Library • Foreplay

title: Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist
description:

About Us:

Mega Land Pros is a leading real estate investment firm that is focused on acquiring and managing real estate assets. Our highly experienced team specializes in identifying opportunities, closing transactions efficiently, and delivering exceptional results.



Job Description:

We are seeking a detail-oriented individual to join our team as a Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist representative. This role will be critical in acquiring, negotiating, and analyzing land deals for our sales pipeline.



This is a long-term, full-time position. You will be working directly with our U.S. team during eastern business hours.



Responsibilities:

• Send our SMS campaigns using Smarter Contact using our library of scripts.

• Label and organize every lead correctly

• Follow company texting scripts and processes

• Make outbound cold calls to landowners and potential sellers daily

• Present offers to sellers

• Negotiate when necessary and work toward getting contracts signed

• Identify motivated sellers and gather key property details

• Generate qualified leads daily

• Research land values using Zillow, Redfin, Google, and other tools

• Update CRM with seller details, offers, and follow-up notes

• Send contracts via DocuSign and track agreements

• Generate comparable sales for properties

• Market analysis and research

• If needed, coordinate with title companies, buyers, sellers, and attorneys

• Follow SOPs and checklists

• **Strong spoken English with minimal accent to communicate effectively with US-based clients**

• High energy with excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Takes full ownership

• Follows checklists

• Meets deadlines

• Communicate clearly

• Ability to learn and work independently

• Dependable internet connection and a quiet work environment



Soft Skills needed:

• Strong and fluent in speaking and writing English

• Detail orientated

• Kind and empathetic



Working Hours:

• Must be available between 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM Eastern Time

• No other jobs are to be worked during this time. Working another job will result in immediate dismissal.



Pay:

• Base Salary between $4/hr-$8/hr+ (depending on experience)

• Performance-based cash bonus: $150-$350

• On-time payments



Why Join Us:

• Work with a dynamic team of professionals in a high-growth industry focused on land investment

• Flexible, remote work environment that fosters independence and creativity

• Opportunity for rapid career advancement within the firm

• Competitive compensation with performance-based bonuses

Record a 3-5 minute Loom video with an introduction of yourself, then answer the following questions:

.

title: Virtual Assistant / Operations & Compliance Administrator

Location: Philippines — Remote

Position: Virtual Assistant / Operations & Compliance Administrator

Industry: UK Insulation, Energy Efficiency & Property Improvements



IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



DO NOT APPLY unless you have previous, demonstrable experience working for a UK insulation, retrofit, energy-efficiency or closely related compliance-focused company.



We are NOT looking for a general virtual assistant who needs to learn the industry from scratch.



You must have practical experience managing installation administration, compliance documentation, customer job files and operational processes.



Experience with ECO4, PAS 2030, PAS 2035, TrustMark or similar UK retrofit programmes is highly desirable, but this is NOT an ECO4-specific role.



Applicants who cannot clearly demonstrate relevant industry experience will not be considered.



About Safe Eco-Fixes Ltd



Safe Eco-Fixes Ltd is a UK-based insulation and property improvement company specialising in cavity wall insulation, loft insulation, spray foam removal and associated property improvement services.



We are expanding our operations and developing structured administrative, quality assurance and compliance systems to support our continued growth.



We have created comprehensive Company and Installation Quality Management Systems (QMS), along with an Operations & Administration Playbook.



We are now seeking an experienced, highly organised Virtual Assistant to take responsibility for the day-to-day administration of these systems and help ensure our operations run efficiently.



You will work closely with the Managing Director, who will provide support and guidance.



Key Responsibilities



Operations & Customer Administration



- Managing customer enquiries, job files and appointments.

- Coordinating surveys, installations and customer communications.

- Liaising with surveyors, installers, subcontractors and management.

- Monitoring job progress from initial enquiry through to completion.

- Ensuring all required documents are completed and filed correctly.



Quality Management & Compliance



- Maintaining our Company QMS and Installation QMS.

- Following and implementing our Operations & Administration Playbook.

- Maintaining compliance registers, checklists and supporting evidence.

- Monitoring company insurance, certifications and renewal dates.

- Maintaining staff and subcontractor competency, training and qualification records.

- Supporting internal audits, corrective actions and management reviews.



Installation Administration



- Checking survey reports, installation paperwork and completion records.

- Collecting and organising before, during and after installation photographs.

- Recording insulation material batch numbers, including EPS bead and adhesive, against individual jobs.

- Maintaining material traceability and installation records.

- Monitoring equipment inspections, maintenance, PAT testing and calibration where applicable.

- Ensuring outstanding documentation and compliance issues are followed up.

- Preparing customer completion, handover and guarantee documentation.



Systems & Reporting



- Maintaining organised Google Drive folders and document structures.

- Updating Excel spreadsheets, registers and job trackers.

- Monitoring outstanding tasks and deadlines.

- Producing regular progress and compliance reports.

- Identifying missing paperwork, process failures and opportunities for improvement.



Technical assessments, installation approvals and specialist compliance decisions will remain with appropriately authorised personnel.



Essential Experience



You MUST have previous experience with several of the following:



- Administration for UK insulation or retrofit companies.

- Cavity wall insulation, loft insulation or similar installation operations.

title: General Admin & Marketing Support VA | HVAC, Advanced ServiceM8
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with advanced, hands-on ServiceM8 experience (including automations, quote follow-up sequences and SMS templates) and a background running the full job cycle for an Australian trades or field service business will be prioritised for this role.



An Australian air conditioning and refrigeration business needs a part-time VA who can step into ServiceM8 at an advanced level and take immediate ownership of the full job cycle: monitoring every enquiry channel, entering jobs, answering client questions, quoting, booking and invoicing. ServiceM8 depth is the non-negotiable. The owner uses only the basics of the platform and wants a VA who knows it better than he does, can set up the workflows and automations that aren’t being used yet, and never needs to be taught the platform itself.



The second half of the role is marketing. In quieter periods, the VA will run social media, create simple content, send
 campaigns to the client database, and run paid campaigns across Google and Meta. When bookings slow down, marketing needs to kick in to fill the schedule.



Success looks like the owner finishing on the tools and being done for the day, a schedule that keeps the technicians (and an incoming apprentice) fully booked, and a winter that is busier than the last. This coming winter is the test of whether the role moves to full-time.



What You’ll Own



Enquiry Management



Monitor all enquiry channels throughout the shift, including ServiceM8 notifications, the ServiceM8 inbox, website message enquiries and

Follow up missed calls and enquiries captured by the AI receptionist

Enter new enquiries into ServiceM8 with complete client, site and job details

Follow up clients for missing information (address, unit details, photos, access) before progressing the job

Respond to client questions promptly and clearly, escalating technical queries

Make outbound calls through the ServiceM8 phone app for important matters only, as calls are charged per minute



Quoting



Prepare and send quotes in ServiceM8

Monitor ServiceM8’s automated five-step quote follow-up sequence and act on anything it misses



Booking & Scheduling



Book accepted jobs in ServiceM8 and confirm bookings with clients

Keep the schedule as full as possible for the field team, including a trainee and an incoming apprentice

Send booking confirmations and appointment reminders

Maintain accurate job statuses from quoted through to booked and completed



Invoicing



Issue invoices from ServiceM8 on job completion (syncs automatically to Xero)

Submit invoices through the relevant real estate agency’s platform for property management jobs (such as Ourtradie/OurProperty and Tapi), confirming the correct submission method for each agency

Follow up overdue invoices



Marketing Support



Prioritise admin first, stepping up marketing activity when bookings slow to keep the schedule full

Post on
 and Instagram via Meta Business Suite, respond to comments and messages, and create simple content and video edits

Develop and send
 campaigns to the client database, such as seasonal service offers

Review the existing, currently paused Google Ads account, then plan and run paid campaigns across Google and Meta

Submit all new marketing activity for approval before it goes live



Daily Communication & Systems



Send a start-of-shift WhatsApp message confirming log-on and the day’s priorities

Send an end-of-day
 report covering tasks completed, work in progress, and items needing approval, attention or review

Document each task as an SOP during handover, using recordings of live training

Build advanced ServiceM8 knowledge and recommend workflow, template and automation improvements



What We’re Looking For



Experience



At least 2 years’ VA experience, ideally with Australian trades or field service businesses

Hands-on experience running the full job cycle for a trades business: enquiry, job setup, quoting, booking and invoicing

Experience with real estate and property management platforms such as Ourtradie/OurProperty and Tapi is a strong advantage, and you should be comfortable learning new agency portals quickly

Air conditioning, refrigeration or other service trade experience is a strong advantage



Communication Skills



Strong written English for enquiry replies and client
s: prompt, warm and clear

Clear spoken English at a measured pace on the phone, as you will call clients when needed

Comfortable answering client questions and knowing when to pass technical ones on



Technical Proficiency



ServiceM8: advanced and non-negotiable, including automations, quote follow-up sequences, SMS templates and the ServiceM8 phone app

Comfortable managing several inboxes and enquiry channels at once

Social media posting and replies, Meta Business Suite, Canva, basic video editing, and using AI tools to create content

Proven experience running Meta Ads, Google Ads and
 campaigns is highly valued; some genuine paid ads exposure is expected

Basic awareness of Xero only; invoicing runs through ServiceM8 and bookkeeping is out of scope



Organisational Skills



Keeps an eye on three or four enquiry channels and makes sure nothing gets missed

Keeps ServiceM8 job statuses accurate from quote to booking to invoice

Plans the day so admin comes first and marketing fills the gaps



Non-Negotiables



Advanced ServiceM8 knowledge, with no platform training needed

Uses quiet days productively without being told what to do

Suggests improvements to ServiceM8 workflows, templates and automations

Writes up SOPs from live screen-share training and learned knowledge of the business

Straight talker: gives clear answers and clear status, and says so when they don’t know something, then finds out

Batches questions and updates into morning and end-of-day messages rather than sending a stream of interruptions

Understands HVAC job types (installs, servicing and breakdowns) and the seasonality of the work

Trustworthy and discreet with client data and business logins

Comfortable taking direction from two points of contact



Working Arrangements



Part-time to start, afternoon shift: 1:00pm to 5:00pm Brisbane time

Open to, and genuinely wanting, a move to full-time as the role grows

Workload rises and falls with the season: busier admin in summer, more marketing in winter

Scheduling responsibility grows over the next 12 months as the field team expands



Why This Role



Genuine ownership of the full job cycle in a business that wants you to know the platform better than they do

Freedom to build and improve ServiceM8 workflows and automations that aren’t being used yet

A direct link between your marketing work and a full schedule, with real, visible results

A clear path to full-time, with the field team and your scope growing over the next year



How to Apply



To be considered, please complete this form and include a short video introduction, ideally one that clearly demonstrates your spoken English. It helps us shortlist quickly:

E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS ASSISTANT

MORALVE | JOB DESCRIPTION

Department: E-commerce Operations | Reports To: Operations & Supply Chain Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time | Work Arrangement: Remote



POSITION OVERVIEW

MORALVE is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, resourceful, and proactive E-commerce Operations Assistant to support the daily operations of our growing e-commerce business.



This versatile, hands-on role covers marketplace and account health monitoring, inventory tracking, customer service, logistics coordination, data entry, administrative support, and ongoing system and database maintenance.



The primary purpose is to ensure daily operations run smoothly, information remains accurate and current, and recurring tasks are monitored, documented, and completed. The assistant works closely with the Operations & Supply Chain Manager across Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.



We value reliability, initiative, follow-through, adaptability, and willingness to learn as much as previous technical experience. As familiarity develops, the role can progress from task execution toward independent ownership of routine workflows, exception identification, and project coordination.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Marketplace Account Monitoring & Maintenance

• Perform daily and recurring checks across Amazon and other assigned marketplaces.

• Monitor account health, notifications, alerts, warnings, and pending action items.



2. Inventory Monitoring & Maintenance

• Monitor inventory availability and stock health across marketplaces and inventory systems.

• Track replenishments, transfers, inbound activity, and receiving updates.

• Update inventory trackers and compare internal data against marketplace records.



3. Customer Service & Customer Experience Support

• Monitor and respond to routine customer inquiries using established guidelines and templates.

• Support order inquiries, delivery concerns, returns, refunds, and replacements within approved authority.

• Track unresolved cases, document actions, and follow up to closure.

• Identify recurring product or service issues and escalate sensitive or nonstandard cases.



4. Logistics, Shipment & Order Monitoring

• Monitor shipment and logistics updates, communications, and operational notifications.

• Maintain shipment trackers and milestones, including estimated arrival, delivery, and receiving.

• Assist with Amazon FBA, AWD, and other marketplace inbound monitoring.

• Record shipment references and organize supporting documents.

• Follow up on missing routine updates and flag delays or discrepancies.



5. Purchase Order & Supplier Coordination Support

• Maintain purchase order records, production updates, and related tracking systems.

• Monitor supplier communications, completion dates, inspection updates, and outstanding information.

• Collect quotations, documents, and routine supplier information.



6. Data Entry, Database & Tracker Maintenance

• Perform accurate recurring data entry and maintenance in spreadsheets, trackers, and databases.

• Update records using verified
s, reports, marketplace information, and supplier communications.

• Identify duplicate, missing, outdated, or inconsistent data.

• Assist with historical backtracking, cleanup, cross-checking, and reconciliation.

• Follow established data standards, formatting, and naming conventions.



7.
, Communication & Task Management

• Monitor assigned operational inboxes and channels; categorize and label communications.

• Identify and execute routine actions, follow-ups, documentation, and escalation.

• Track outstanding requests and pending responses.

• Communicate updates to internal and external stakeholders as appropriate.



8. Document & File Organization

• Download, rename, categorize, and store operational files according to company standards.

• Organize product, shipment, purchase order, inspection, supplier, and customer service documents.

• Support historical file cleanup and ensure records are traceable to their transactions.



9. Routine Operational & Administrative Support

• Complete assigned daily, weekly, and monthly checklists and maintenance tasks.

• Assist with account checks, reporting, data collection, research, and administrative activities.

• Support routine coordination across departments and evolving business needs.



10. Project Coordination & Process Improvement

• Maintain assigned project boards, task lists, deadlines, and documentation.

• Track deliverables, follow up on action items, and report blockers early.

• Assist with small operational projects and SOP documentation.

• Suggest practical improvements to accuracy, organization, and efficiency.



QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Experience in at least 3 areas: : e-commerce operations, virtual assistance, administrative support, customer service, marketplace management, inventory/order management, logistics support, or data entry.

• Working knowledge of Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel, including basic formulas, sorting, filtering, and organizing data.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, written and verbal English communication.

• Ability to interpret
s, spreadsheets, reports, and operational systems and determine routine next steps.

• Ability to manage recurring responsibilities, follow SOPs, and work independently in a remote environment.

• Reliability, accountability, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn.



Preferred

• Experience with Amazon Seller Central or similar platforms.

• Familiarity with marketplace account health, listings, inventory, orders, and e-commerce customer service.

• Experience with Google Workspace and project tools such as 
, ClickUp, Asana, or Notion.

• Basic familiarity with Amazon FBA/AWD, shipments, purchase orders, and replenishment.

• Experience working with suppliers or logistics providers and maintaining SOPs or operational trackers.



KEY COMPETENCIES

Attention to Detail - Maintains accurate records and recognizes inconsistencies.

Reliability & Consistency - Completes recurring responsibilities on time.

Ownership & Accountability - Takes responsibility and follows tasks to completion.

Proactiveness - Identifies missing information, pending actions, and potential issues.

Problem-Solving - Investigates and proposes possible solutions before escalation.

Learning Agility - Learns new tools and processes quickly.

Organization & Prioritization - Distinguishes urgent issues from routine tasks.

Communication & Follow-Through - Provides timely updates and closes loops.

Adaptability - Supports changing needs across operational functions.

Process Discipline & Judgment - Follows SOPs and recognizes when approval is required.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK WITH



A consumer finance app that handles sensitive customer data and documents (FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Next.js)

Browser automation (Playwright)

AI features using the Claude and OpenAI APIs

Website, chat and messaging assistants (Vercel, Python, GoHighLevel)

Payments, mail and SMS integrations

A Linux VPS on DigitalOcean

Audit each app and give us an honest list of what works, what’s broken and what’s missing

Fix bugs and complete the customer journey from signup to finished result

Test AI features against real scenarios, including wrong answers and attempts to trick them

Set up secure hosting, automated backups with tested restores, secrets management, monitoring and alerts

Put all code in Git, with automated tests and a safe way to deploy and roll back

Run supervised live tests, then launch and support each app

Write simple documentation so someone else could run the system



WHAT “DONE” MEANS

A real customer can complete the whole process without our help. Tests pass, backups restore, errors alert us, and every launch step has been proven live.



REQUIREMENTS

Strong Python and JavaScript/TypeScript

Production experience with FastAPI or similar, PostgreSQL, Docker and Redis

Clear written English and honest status updates, including when something is broken or you’re stuck

Reliable computer, internet and backup power

Playwright, GoHighLevel, payment or webhook integrations

Fintech or other regulated-industry experience



HOW WE HIRE



Short application review

Video call

title: Loan Processor
description:
Loan Processor Job Description



• Conduct detailed serviceability checks to confirm applicants can meet repayment obligations, using relevant calculators and tools.

• Check loan scenarios against individual lender credit policies to confirm eligibility and identify potential issues before proceeding.

• Research and compare suitable lender products, interest rates, and policies to identify the best-fit options for each client's circumstances.

• Evaluate the financial position of loan applicants to determine borrowing capacity, analysing income, expenses, and existing debt obligations.

• Collect all required documents from loan applicants, including income statements, credit reports, and identification documents, and verify their authenticity and completeness.

• Prepare loan proposals presenting suitable lender options based on the client's situation and lender policies, and ensure all proposals are reviewed with the broker.

• Ensure all documents are accurate, complete, and meet lender requirements prior to lodgement.

• Input client and loan data accurately into CRM systems and submit applications to lenders via the appropriate online portals.

• Act as the central point of contact for brokers, clients, and lenders throughout the application process, providing timely progress updates and addressing queries accurately.

• Follow up with lenders and/or clients via phone or email for updates and outstanding requirements.

• Coordinate with underwriters, brokers, and internal tea
mbers to resolve any issues arising during assessment or processing.

• Continuously develop and maintain knowledge of lender policies, products, and credit criteria through training and self-study.

• Follow up all cases from formal approval through to settlement, including checking loan documents upon issuance and following up on outstanding settlement conditions.

• Ensure the outgoing financier (OFI) is ready for settlement where applicable (refinances).

• Advise clients on funds required to complete settlement, and liaise with all relevant parties — solicitors, lenders, and agents — to ensure files are ready.

• Notify clients once settlement is booked, send settlement breakdowns, and complete the settlement checklist in the system.

• Set up post-settlement action plans and support clients with ongoing loan maintenance enquiries and requests.

• Follow up with clients every six months, handle loan change requests, and apply and confirm cash rebates.

• Conduct birthday and annual reviews, including follow-up on fixed rate expiries.

• Manage construction progress drawdowns: collect and follow up on construction document checklists, follow up on commencement letters, and track construction progress through to completion.



Qualifications:

• Minimum 2–3 years of Australian mortgage broking or lending experience.

• Demonstrated experience with Australian Mortgage CRM platforms (e.g., Mercury, MyCRM, Salestrekker, Flex)

• Strong understanding of lender credit policies, serviceability requirements, and loan structures.

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and document management.

• High level of written and spoken English communication skills.

• Analytical mindset with strong numeracy skills.

• Excellent problem-solving ability and a proactive, solutions-focused approach.

• Strong interpersonal skills and a client-first approach.

title: Python Data Engineer – Web Scraping, ETL & Data Enrichment
description:
Experience: 3+ years preferred

Location: Philippines (Remote)



About the Role



We are building a data intelligence platform that collects, structures, and presents detailed information about companies, people, investors, industries, and business relationships.



Our platform will aggregate information from multiple licensed and permitted data sources, including company databases, professional networks, industry reports, PDFs, public records, and APIs.



We are looking for an experienced Python Data Engineer / Web Scraping Specialist to help build and manage the data infrastructure behind our platform.



We need someone who can develop reliable, scalable, and automated systems to collect, clean, structure, enrich, and continuously update large amounts of business information.



You will work directly with the founder to develop our data acquisition and processing systems from the ground up.



Key Responsibilities



1. Web Scraping & Data Collection



Build and maintain Python-based web scraping and data extraction tools.



Collect structured data from permitted websites, public databases, and licensed sources.



Extract company profiles, executive information, investment history, funding rounds, industry classifications, and business relationships.



Develop automated processes for regularly updating existing records.



Work with websites containing dynamic JavaScript-rendered content.



Integrate third-party APIs and licensed data providers.



2. Data Extraction from PDFs & Documents



Extract structured information from industry research reports, financial documents, and PDFs.



Process tables, company lists, financial information, and other unstructured datasets.



Use AI/LLMs where appropriate to convert unstructured documents into structured, verifiable data.



3. Data Cleaning, Enrichment & Matching



Clean, normalize, and standardize large datasets.



Identify and remove duplicate company and people records.



Match companies and individuals across multiple data sources.



Merge information into unified company and executive profiles.



Develop processes to identify missing information, conflicting records, and inaccurate data.



4. Data Engineering & Automation



Build automated ETL/ELT pipelines.



Design and manage structured databases.



Work with PostgreSQL, SQL, JSON, CSV, and APIs.



Develop scheduled data collection and refresh processes.



Implement error handling, monitoring, logging, and data quality checks.



Maintain records of data sources, extraction dates, and provenance.



5. Database & Dashboard Integration



Prepare clean, structured datasets for our internal and customer-facing dashboards.



Integrate processed data with tools such as Noloco, 
, and other platforms where appropriate.



Ensure data can be efficiently searched, filtered, and updated.



Required Skills



You should have strong practical experience with:



Python – advanced proficiency



Web scraping – Scrapy, BeautifulSoup, Playwright, Selenium, or similar tools



Data engineering – ETL pipelines, automation, and scheduled workflows



SQL / PostgreSQL – relational database design and querying



Data processing – Pandas, JSON, CSV, data transformation



API integration – REST APIs, authentication, pagination, and data ingestion



Data cleaning – deduplication, normalization, and entity matching



PDF extraction – extracting structured data from reports and documents



Git – version control and maintainable, documented code



You must be comfortable working independently, solving technical problems, and building systems that can run repeatedly without constant manual intervention.



All extraction and integration work must follow applicable laws, source permissions, and licensing agreements.



Bonus Skills



These are not essential but would be highly valuable:



Experience building company intelligence, financial data, or business information databases



Familiarity with Crunchbase, PitchBook, LinkedIn, ITjuzi, or similar business data platforms



Experience with AI/LLM-based document extraction and data enrichment



Experience with Chinese-language websites and datasets



Experience with Supabase, AWS, or other cloud infrastructure



Experience with 
 or Noloco



Experience managing large-scale datasets containing hundreds of thousands or millions of records



Experience with entity resolution and knowledge graphs



What We're Looking For



We want someone who:



Has built real-world scraping and data processing systems, not just simple scripts



Understands how to turn messy data from multiple sources into a reliable database



Can recommend better technical approaches rather than simply following instructions



Writes clean, organized, and maintainable Python code



Is highly detail-oriented and understands data accuracy



Can work independently and communicate progress clearly



Is interested in a long-term role helping build a growing data intelligence business



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



A brief introduction and summary of your Python/data engineering experience.



Examples of web scraping or ETL systems you have built.



Your experience working with SQL databases and large datasets.



Whether you have worked with company profiles, people data, investment databases, or similar datasets.



Your monthly salary expectation in USD.



Your GitHub profile or examples of previous code, if available.



Technical question:



Imagine you need to build a database containing 5000 companies. Information comes from multiple websites, APIs, and PDF reports. Many companies appear under different names, and information changes over time.



How would you design a system to collect the data, match duplicate records, verify information, and keep the database continuously updated?



Please briefly explain the technologies and approach you would use.



Applications that demonstrate practical experience and a clear technical approach will be prioritized.



We are looking for someone who can grow with the business and eventually take ownership of our data engineering infrastructure.
