title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
# Executive Assistant to the CEO

**Mami Wander Media | Full-Time | Remote | Philippines**



**Compensation: $200 USD Weekly Base Salary + Up to $1,000 Quarterly Performance Bonuses**



Hi!



I'm looking for a highly experienced, extremely organized, and proactive Executive Assistant to work directly with me as the CEO of Mami Wander Media.



I'm looking for someone who can become my **right hand** — someone who helps me stay organized, manages my schedule, keeps track of everything happening across my company, and makes sure important tasks, projects, and deadlines never fall through the cracks.



I run a growing creator media company focused heavily on TikTok Shop affiliate content, along with content across Instagram,
, YouTube, and Threads.



We have a lot of moving parts, multiple projects, ongoing content production, team communications, deadlines, and daily priorities.



I need someone who can help me manage all of it.



**The most important thing I'm looking for is someone who is EXTREMELY organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and experienced in supporting a busy CEO or entrepreneur.**



I don't want to have to constantly remind someone what needs to get done. I want someone who can help remind ME, keep me accountable, anticipate what needs my attention, and make my day-to-day life easier.



### Important: TikTok Shop Affiliate Knowledge Is Required



Because TikTok Shop is such a major part of our business, you MUST have real experience or strong working knowledge of the TikTok Shop affiliate creator world.



You should understand:



- How TikTok Shop affiliate creators make money.

- The process of researching and selecting products to promote.

- How product samples, sample requests, and product collaborations work.

- The process of creating, organizing, and posting TikTok Shop affiliate videos.

- How products are linked to shoppable videos.

- How affiliate commissions, GMV, and content performance work.

- How TikTok Shop affiliate campaigns and creator workflows operate.

- The importance of posting consistency, content deadlines, and product deliverables.

- The general TikTok Shop creator ecosystem, including common platform challenges and opportunities.



**You do not need to be the person creating all of our content, running our TikTok Shop operations, or negotiating brand deals.**



However, you MUST understand this industry well enough to follow our projects, communicate with our team, understand what we're working on, and help me stay organized across all areas of the business.



If you have never worked in or closely supported the TikTok Shop affiliate creator industry, this position is not the right fit.



### Your Main Responsibilities



**1. Executive & Personal Assistance**



Your number one responsibility is helping me stay organized and operate efficiently as CEO.



- Manage my daily calendar, appointments, and meetings.

- Help organize my personal and professional schedules.

- Prepare my daily agenda and priorities.

- Remind me of important tasks, deadlines, and commitments.

- Help me plan my days, weeks, and upcoming projects.

- Organize my ideas and turn them into actionable tasks.

- Follow up with me on things that require my attention.

- Help me stay focused on high-priority activities.

- Anticipate scheduling conflicts and upcoming needs.



**2. Project & Task Management**



Mami Wander Media has multiple projects happening at the same time. I need someone who can help me keep track of everything.



- Organize and manage projects using Notion and 
.

- Maintain an accurate master list of ongoing projects and priorities.

- Track tasks, assignments, deadlines, and project progress.

- Follow up with team members on outstanding assignments.

- Make sure projects continue moving forward.

- Identify bottlenecks, delays, and unfinished tasks.

- Prepare project status updates for me.

- Help break larger projects into smaller actionable steps.

- Keep me informed about what is completed, pending, or requires my decision.



**3. Team Communication & Accountability**



- Help coordinate communication between me and the team.

- Monitor assigned 
 channels and communications.

- Follow up with team members regarding deliverables.

- Track deadlines and ensure assignments are not forgotten.

- Organize meeting notes and action items.

- Help prepare team meeting agendas.

- Send reminders and request status updates.

- Escalate important problems before they become bigger issues.



**4. Administrative Organization**



- Organize and manage Google Calendar, Gmail, Google Drive, Docs, and Sheets.

- Maintain organized company folders, files, and records.

- Create and update trackers, spreadsheets, and administrative documents.

- Help organize internal systems and workflows.

- Prepare summaries, reports, and presentations.

- Keep important company information accessible and organized.

- Handle confidential business and personal information with discretion.



**5. Media Company Coordination**



Because our business revolves around content creation and TikTok Shop affiliates, you'll also help me stay organized with:



- Content calendars and publishing schedules.

- TikTok Shop affiliate-related projects.

- Product and content deadlines.

- Team deliverables and ongoing campaigns.

- Administrative coordination across TikTok, Instagram,
, YouTube, and Threads.

- Tracking outstanding items and identifying what needs my attention.



Your role is to help me oversee and organize these moving parts, not personally perform every specialized operational task.



Brand deal pricing and negotiation remain with me, while brand-facing outreach remains with our Operations Specialist.



### What I'm Looking For



I want someone who thinks ahead.



Someone who doesn't just wait for instructions but understands what needs to happen next.



For example:



If I mention an idea during a meeting, I want you to capture it, organize it, and help turn it into a project.



If I have an important deadline coming up, I want you reminding me before I even think about it.



If a team member hasn't completed something, I want you following up and letting me know what's happening.



If my schedule is becoming overwhelming, I want you helping me reorganize and prioritize it.



If there are 20 different projects happening, I want you to know where they all stand and what needs my attention.



**Ultimately, I want someone who helps bring structure, organization, and accountability to my day and to the company.**



### Non-Negotiable Requirements



- Minimum **5 years of experience** as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or similar executive support role.

- Strong working knowledge or direct experience in the TikTok Shop affiliate creator industry.

- Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

- Professional, fluent written and spoken English.

- Experience using Google Workspace, Notion, 
, and 
.

- Working knowledge of TikTok Shop and Meta social media platforms.

- Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

- Strong follow-through and attention to detail.

- Proactive communication and independent problem-solving.

- Ability to work directly with a CEO and maintain confidentiality.

- Reliable daily attendance and early communication about any problems.

- Stable internet connection, personal computer, and backup internet or power plan.

- Ability to use a VPN for authorized work systems.

- Availability for 8 working hours per day, including a daily check-in during Pacific Time mornings.



### Compensation & Growth Opportunity



This is a long-term, full-time position.



**Compensation:**

- $200 USD per week base salary.

- Up to $1,000 USD in quarterly performance bonuses.

- Potential total annual compensation of $14,400 USD.

- Initial two-week paid trial with clearly defined expectations.



Quarterly bonuses will be based on performance, including organization, task completion, deadline management, communication, reliability, and executive support.



I'm looking for someone who wants to grow with Mami Wander Media and become an essential part of our leadership support structure.



### How to Apply



We expect to receive many applications, so please follow these instructions carefully.



Send ONE complete application
 to:







Your application MUST include:



1. **Resume:** Your updated resume highlighting your executive assistant experience.



2. **Portfolio:** Examples of organizational systems, calendars, project trackers, dashboards, or workflows you have personally created or managed. Remove all private or confidential information.



3. **TikTok Shop Experience:** A brief explanation of your experience with the TikTok Shop affiliate creator industry and the types of creators, teams, or businesses you have supported.



4. **Professional References:** At least two professional references, including name, position,
 address, and your working relationship. By submitting references, you authorize Mami Wander Media to contact them for professional verification.



5. **Introduction:** A short explanation of why you believe you would be an excellent Executive Assistant to the CEO.



6. **Software Experience:** Describe your proficiency with Google Workspace, Notion, 
, 
, TikTok Shop, and Meta social media.



7. **Availability:** Confirm your ability to work full-time, your availability for Pacific morning check-ins, and your earliest possible start date.



### Attention to Detail Test



To prove you read this entire posting, include the word **GLITTER** in the subject line of your application
.



Applications missing this word or any required application materials will not be considered.



Qualified applicants will be invited to complete a structured interview process, followed by a practical assessment and a two-week paid trial.



**I'm not simply looking to hire another assistant. I'm looking for someone who can become a trusted, dependable right hand and help me manage everything that comes with running and growing Mami Wander Media.**



If that sounds like you, I look forward to reviewing your application.

title: KYB/KYC Team Lead
description:
Work Setup: Remote | Philippines

Employment Type: Full-Time

Department: Compliance



About Us



We have been an international company working with a remote team in the Philippines since 2008.

We value professionalism, collaboration, and the ability to adapt in a fast-paced global environment.

Our team thrives on mutual respect, accountability, and continuous improvement, and we’re looking for someone who shares these values.



About You



We are looking for a highly accurate, detail-oriented, and analytical KYC/KYB Analyst to join our Compliance team. You will be responsible for conducting KYC and KYB checks, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting our onboarding and verification processes. The ideal candidate has strong attention to detail, works with integrity, and is comfortable handling sensitive information.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own end-to-end KYC and KYB reviews for individual and corporate customers, from onboarding through approval, rejection, or escalation.

- Review and verify identity documents, proof of address, company registration documents, and complex ownership and control structures, identifying all ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) and controllers.

- Carry out Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) on high-risk customers, including PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions, complex or opaque structures, crypto/Web3 businesses and unusual activity profiles.

- Assess and evidence source of funds and source of wealth, and challenge customers where the explanation or documents are inconsistent or insufficient.

- Perform AML screening (sanctions, PEP, adverse media), resolve potential matches and document a clear rationale for each decision.

- Complete customer risk assessments, assign risk ratings and recommend approval, conditional approval or rejection for complex and high-risk cases.

- Escalate suspicious activity and red flags to the Head of Compliance, with well-documented case summaries to support any internal suspicious activity report.

- Run periodic reviews and re-verification based on customer risk level, including trigger-based reviews when ownership, activity or risk profile changes.

- Manage verification workflows in Sumsub (or similar KYC/AML tools), including configuring checks, resolving system issues and flagging improvements.

- Respond to requests for information (RFIs) from banking and payment partners, preparing clear, complete case files within agreed timelines

- Work with Support, Business, Product and Tech teams across multiple business units to resolve discrepancies, chase outstanding information and unblock stuck cases.

- Contribute to improving KYC/KYB procedures, checklists and risk-assessment frameworks in line with regulatory requirements and partner expectations.

- Keep accurate, audit-ready records for every check and decision.

- Handle confidential and sensitive customer data with discretion, in line with data protection requirements.



REQUIREMENTS:

• 1–3 years of proven, hands-on experience in KYC and KYB verification, with a strong focus on reviewing and validating KYB documentation

• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, with the ability to efficiently identify inconsistencies, risks, and missing information

• Proven experience following and adhering to internal SOPs, regulatory requirements, and compliance guidelines

• Hands-on experience using Sumsub or similar AML/KYC tools (e.g., Veriff, Onfido, Persona, ComplyAdvantage)

• Solid understanding of AML, KYC, and compliance processes, particularly in a B2B context

• Clear and professional communication skills, both written and verbal

• Comfortable working independently and managing time effectively

• Availability: Must be available and responsive during the agreed 8-hour shift

• Good Internet Connection: Reliable and stable for remote work

• Must have a Wise account or reside in a location that supports Wise



Only qualified candidates will be contacted!



Apply Now!

title: Creator Research Specialist
description:
Scope of Work (General Job Description)



RESEARCH SPECIALIST needed to build a list of finance short-form video creators (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) for topic research. The list has one job: capture what topics actually perform — every row must include the creator's top-performing videos so I can study what works.



Your outcome is to:

1. Build a list of 50 finance short-form creators within the parameters below who match our requirements.

2. Focus on creators with real engagement, not just follower counts. Average views matter more than followers.

3. Every row must include topic research. No rows without top-performing videos.



Key Bullet Points

• Required: FINANCE-FOCUSED short-form creator — the majority of their videos must be about investing, personal finance, markets, economics, or fintech. A lifestyle creator who "sometimes talks about money" does not count.

• Required: Active in the last 30 days — at least 4 finance videos posted in the last 30 days. Short-form moves fast; dormant accounts are useless.

• Required: 50,000–1,000,000 followers on their primary platform. Big enough to matter, small enough to be able to replicate their content. (Mega-creators with millions of followers are ok. Note them separately if you find good ones, but they don't count toward the 50.)

• Required: Top 3 performing videos linked for EVERY row. Video link plus view count. This is the topic research; do not skip it.

• Required: Submit a list of exactly 50 creators. No duplicates.

• Ideal: Leans on credibility/authority positioning (credentials, career background, "ex-Wall Street" style framing) — these are the best comps for my positioning, so flag them.

• Ideal: Strong engagement - average views at least 10% of follower count, or clearly viral outliers in recent videos.

• Ideal: Already does brand deals or sponsorships (proven they treat it as a business).



Overview & Details

I'm a software engineer at a big tech company (Princeton grad, 2350/2400 SAT) and have been investing early across different vehicles and learned a lot from doing so. I started out reselling things at a young age to get my first capital though. I'm building short-form finance video content (TikTok/Reels/Shorts), explaining investing and personal finance related topics. My positioning leans on real credentials and clear explanations, not hype. I want to study what topics perform. The list exists as a topic-research database I can mine for video ideas.

Good audience fit: retail investors, savers, and personal-finance learners, people who watch short videos to get smarter about money.



Your goal is to build a list of 50 ideal creators for topic research.



Examples of Creators We've Looked At

• "Humphrey Yang — TikTok/YouTube Shorts, ex-financial advisor, explains complex finance topics in 60 seconds with pop-culture hooks. Type of creator we want: credible background, short-form native, consistent poster. (Too big at 3M+ followers to count toward the 50 — direction example only.)"

• "Vivian Tu / Your Rich BFF — TikTok/Instagram, former Wall Street trader, personal finance made accessible. Great topic research: see which of her money-tip formats go viral. (Too big — direction example only.)"

• "Jim Wang 
 — won Best Short-Form Content at the 2026 FinTalk Awards. Exactly the tier and format we're targeting: recognized short-form finance creator."

• "Erika Kullberg — attorney + personal finance, 9M+ TikTok, consumer money tips and legal money hacks. Study her hook style. 

(These are direction examples for content style and topic research, not exclusions — the 50 rows should be creators in the 50k–1M band. Your judgment on fit matters more than copying the examples.)



List Building Details

Please build the list in a Google Sheet. Include the following columns:

• Creator name / handle — name 
 Primary platform — TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts (note if active on multiple).

• Profile link — direct link to their profile.

• Follower count — count and platform ("~85k TikTok followers").

• Average views — rough average views per finance video over the last 30 days.

• Finance niche — one line: value investing, personal finance, crypto, day trading, budgeting, etc.

• Creator contact — business
 from bio/Linktree if available; otherwise business-inquiry link. Never leave this blank.

• Contact type — &quot
" or "DM/link" (so I know how warm the row is).

• Top 3 videos — links to their 3 highest-viewed finance videos, with view counts. This is the topic research — the most important column after contact info.

• Posting cadence — videos per week (from recent activity).

• Description — a short description of why this creator was selected and why they'd be a good contact (2-3 sentences).



How This Hire Works

1. Apply as described below. Applications that skip the sample creators will not be considered — that sample is the first test.

2. Shortlisted applicants (2–3) will be offered a paid sample test: a small slice of the real list (5 completed rows in the full column format above), fixed price, with a stated deadline.

3. The winner of the paid test builds the full 50-creator list at the fixed price agreed in the application stage. Payment is direct (EasyPay or Wise) 



To Apply

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph for this job post, with the application title: "Finance Short-Form Creator List Building Application"

INCLUDE:

• 3-5 finance short-form creators you think would be ideal for this project — handle, platform, profile link, and follower count for each. And tell me WHY you chose them (2-3 sentences each). Include one of their top-performing video topics. Thoughtful descriptions will get you the job. This is the most important part of the application.

• A short description of your experience building contact/research lists, and why you're confident you can do this work.

• Your expected turnaround time to build the 50-creator list.

• Estimated number of hours to complete list



We will NOT consider:

• Applications that don't include the correct title or 3-5 ideal creators.

• Any AI written submissions.

title: AI FILMMAKER / VIDEO DEVELOPER — CREATE SHORT FILMS & SERIES DAILY
description:
We're about to start producing AI-generated short films and episodic series, and we need a dedicated AI video specialist who lives in this work every day. You are the person in the background turning scripts and ideas into finished, polished video — generating, editing, and refining daily. This is a full-time, hands-on production role, not a once-a-week content gig. If you're already making AI films and have the reels to prove it, we want you.



PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING. This is a senior-level AI creative role. You must already be fluent with today's AI video, image, and audio tools and be able to show finished work you personally made. If your experience is only basic video editing, or you've only watched tutorials without shipping real AI-generated films, this isn't the role for you.



MANDATORY EXPERIENCE (hard requirements — do not apply without these)



Proven, hands-on experience creating AI-generated video — short films, series, or narrative content you personally made.

AI video generation: Veo, Runway, Kling, Sora, or equivalent (consistent characters, cinematic shots, scene-to-scene continuity).

AI image generation: Midjourney, Flux, or Stable Diffusion (characters, frames, style, reference images).

AI audio: voice/dialogue (ElevenLabs or similar), plus music/sound (Suno or similar) for scoring and sound design.

Video editing & post: CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or After Effects — to assemble, color, caption, and finish the piece.

A portfolio/reel of AI-generated videos you made yourself (this is required — see application).



STRONGLY PREFERRED



Experience keeping characters and style consistent across scenes and across episodes of a series.

Storytelling and shot/scene sense — you understand pacing, hooks, and what makes a film watchable.

Experience cutting long narrative pieces down into short-form vertical clips (Reels/TikTok/Shorts).

Prompt-writing skill for video/image models — getting the shot you actually want, efficiently.

Comfort learning new AI tools fast as they're released (this space changes monthly).



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Generate AI video daily — produce the shots, scenes, and sequences for our short films and series.

Create characters, environments, and style frames with AI image tools and keep them consistent across scenes and episodes.

Produce and sync AI audio: dialogue/voiceover, music, and sound design.

Edit and finish every piece in post — assembly, timing, color, captions, final export.

Cut finished narrative pieces into short-form vertical clips for social.

Keep a consistent daily output of generated and edited content.

Maintain a library/system for characters, prompts, styles, and assets so work stays consistent and reusable.

Stay current on new AI film tools and bring the best ones into our workflow.



YOUR FIRST MILESTONE



Show us you can take a short script or concept and deliver a finished AI-generated scene — generated, scored, edited, and exported — to our quality bar.

Set up a simple asset/prompt/character system so output stays consistent day to day.

Establish a realistic daily/weekly output pace we agree on together.



We will not set volume targets before seeing your workflow and speed. We set the daily output pace together once we see how you work.



PAID TRIAL BEFORE THE FULL ROLE We don't hand over a monthly salary on faith. Shortlisted candidates do a short PAID trial first:



Length: 5–7 days, fixed.

Pay: a paid trial, paid on delivery — not an open hourly clock. We'll agree the trial amount with you before it starts.

What you deliver by the end of the trial:

One finished AI-generated short scene (30–90 sec) from a concept we give you — generated, scored, edited, exported.

Two short-form vertical clips cut from it.

A short note on your tools, your workflow, and how you'd keep characters/style consistent across a series.

How the trial is judged: the quality of the finished piece, consistency, and how efficiently you work. A paid trial, whether or not we move forward.

Advancement: a strong trial moves you into the full-time role at the base + bonus above.



TO APPLY, ANSWER THESE QUESTIONS



Share your portfolio/reel of AI-generated videos you personally made. Link it. (Required — applications without a reel are not considered.)

Which AI tools do you use for video, image, and audio, and what's your exact workflow from idea to finished film?

How do you keep a character and visual style consistent across multiple scenes and episodes?

What's the most ambitious AI film or series piece you've made? What was hard about it and how did you solve it?

How fast can you turn a short script into a finished 60-second AI scene, and what does your daily output look like?

How do you stay current as new AI video tools come out?

Provide your availability, proposed compensation, and your computer/software setup.



REQUIRED: VIDEO WALKTHROUGH Along with your written answers and reel, include a 3–5 minute screen-recording (Loom) walking us through ONE piece you made — show us the tools, the prompts, and how you edited it together. We want to see your actual process, not just the final result. Applications without this walkthrough will not be reviewed.



Please distinguish your personal work from team work. We value real, shipped AI films and a creator who can produce them consistently, every day.

PAY

title: Tax Manager – Philippine Taxation & Payroll
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Tax Manager to oversee Philippine tax compliance and payroll operations, ensuring accurate reporting, timely submissions, and compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

The ideal candidate has a solid background in Philippine taxation, payroll administration, and statutory compliance, with the ability to work independently in a remote environment and collaborate effectively with the Finance and HR teams.



Roles and Responsibilities

1. Philippine Taxation and Compliance

Manage the preparation, review, and filing of applicable Philippine tax returns and statutory reports.

Ensure timely payment and remittance of taxes in accordance with BIR requirements.

Monitor changes in tax laws and regulations and recommend necessary adjustments to company practices.

Maintain accurate tax records and supporting documentation.

Coordinate tax audits, assessments, and other BIR-related matters as needed.



2. Payroll Management

Oversee payroll processing to ensure accurate and timely salary payments.

Review payroll calculations, including withholding taxes, adjustments, and other applicable deductions.

Ensure proper computation and remittance of statutory contributions, including SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG.

Ensure compliance with applicable payroll-related tax and labor regulations.

Coordinate with HR and Finance to address payroll discrepancies and employee compensation concerns.



3. Reporting and Coordination

Prepare and review tax and payroll reports for management and regulatory purposes.

Maintain organized records for audits and compliance reviews.

Work closely with HR and Finance to ensure accurate employee compensation and statutory reporting.

Identify opportunities to improve tax and payroll processes, accuracy, and efficiency.



Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy, Finance, or a related field.

Certified Public Accountant (CPA) is preferred.

At least 5 years of relevant experience in Philippine taxation, payroll, or accounting, preferably with experience handling both tax compliance and payroll operations.

Working knowledge of Philippine tax laws, BIR regulations, and statutory reporting requirements.

Experience in payroll processing, withholding tax computation, and statutory contributions.

Proficient in spreadsheets and accounting or payroll systems.

Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and confidentiality.

Able to work independently, manage deadlines, and collaborate effectively in a remote work environment.



What We’re Looking For

A detail-oriented and dependable professional who can manage tax and payroll responsibilities, maintain compliance, and support the company’s day-to-day Finance and HR operations.

 campaigns

 banners

• Keep the asset library organized in Google Drive so anyone can find the approved version

• Daily output with same-day revisions. You work from written English briefs and communicate progress, questions and blockers in English



This Role Is For You If

• Strong photo editing and retouching: compositing, masking, colour matching, perspective correction (Photoshop)

• Solid grasp of design fundamentals: typography, colour theory, composition and visual hierarchy. You know why a layout works, not just how to build one

• Video editing: cutting, colour, subtitles, sound, export per platform (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut or similar)

• Product photography: can light and shoot a small device cleanly on a tripod

• Working use of AI image and video tools (Midjourney, Stable Diffusion/ComfyUI, Kling, Seedance, Runway or similar) — and a sharp eye for when AI output looks fake or gets product details wrong

• Can read a written brief and turn it into a finished visual that matches the brief's intent without inventing product features or faking details

• Comfortable working in English — written and spoken (MANDATORY). The briefs, feedback and the team all work in English

• A portfolio showing photo editing, compositing and video work. We need to see work made for Western consumers, or work that would clearly translate

• Figma for ad creative layouts, landing pages and quick iterations with the team



Strong Plus

• Experience producing visuals for Western DTC or Amazon markets

• Performance data on your creative (ROAS, CTR, conversion)

• Basic motion graphics

• Conversion-focused thinking: you design for thumb-stop, click-through and add-to-cart, not just aesthetics



Bonus If

• 3D rendering: Blender, KeyShot or similar

• Hardware or security product experience

• UGC-style video production



A Note on Pace

Daily output, same-day revisions, new briefs every week. During peak ecommerce seasons you'll juggle multiple campaigns at once under tight deadlines. The product line is expanding, so you'll be learning new hardware constantly and turning it into visuals that sell. It's a fit if you manage your own time well, handle pressure without dropping quality, and care about what the numbers say about your work.

If you build creative that sells, obsess over product accuracy, and can work from English briefs, we’d like to talk.

title: Creative Strategist | Meta Ads, DTC, E-commerce, DropShipping
description:
Creative Strategist | Meta Ads, DTC, E-commerce

Full-time | Remote | Philippines daytime hours

$1,800-$2,500/month depending on experience



ABOUT US

We’re an e-commerce team running our own online stores and regularly launching and testing products across different niches. Our work combines customer research, direct-response advertising, and AI-assisted creative production to find products and messages that resonate with buyers.



You’ll work directly with the founder and our existing team of video editors. We’re building a long-term team where people contribute ideas, see them brought to life, and learn from real advertising results.



Alongside our own stores, we’ve recently expanded into creative services for clients and brought on our first account. We’re looking for someone who wants to become a key part of the business, help shape our creative approach, and grow into broader responsibilities as we expand.



ROLE OVERVIEW

You’ll lead creative strategy for our own e-commerce stores and client accounts, d
 what we test and why. You’ll dig into customer reviews, competitor ads, product research, and Meta ad performance to uncover promising audiences, angles, and hooks. Then you’ll turn those insights into scripts and clear briefs for video and static ads, giving our AI video editors the direction they need to bring your ideas to life.



You’ll work with the founder and editors to take concepts through production, review, and testing, using performance results to shape the next round.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Research products, competitors, customer pain points, desires, and objections.

- Develop audiences, angles, hooks, and messaging for our own products and client accounts, with clear reasoning behind what to test and why.

- Write direct-response scripts and briefs for video and static ads, including alternative hooks, headlines, and ad copy.

- Give our AI video editors clear visual direction, including key shots, scene flow, references, and what needs to be generated.

- Help structure creative tests and explain what each concept is intended to test.

- Work closely with the founder and editors to prioritize concepts, coordinate production, and provide actionable feedback on finished creatives.

- Analyze creative performance and use the findings to develop new concepts and variations.

- Keep briefs, creative status, and testing results organized, maintaining a steady flow of ideas through production and testing.

- Spot new formats and trends, and adapt them to each product.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Previous creative strategy and copywriting experience with e-commerce/dropshipping brands.

- Real-world ads you briefed or scripted, with results you can show or talk through.

- Strong understanding of direct-response advertising, and customer psychology.

- Familiarity with Meta ads, current online trends, and different advertising formats.

- Strong written English, storytelling, and communication skills.

- Ability to turn research into clear creative direction and work effectively with editors.

- Comfortable interpreting metrics such as CTR, CPA, and ROAS.

- Previous experience with AI creative is a plus.



WORK ETHIC & OWNERSHIP

This is especially important to us. We want someone who takes ownership, treats our stores and client accounts like their own, and cares about the actual results. That means:

- You bring a plan for what to test next without waiting to be asked.

- When an ad underperforms, you investigate why and propose what to improve.

- You keep fresh concepts moving into production before the team runs out of ideas.

- You meet deadlines and communicate early when something needs attention.

- You measure your contribution by business results, not just completed tasks.



WHAT WE OFFER

- A long-term, full-time, remote role with Philippines daytime working hours.

- $1,800-$2,500 per month with a clear path to salary increases as you deliver and as we grow.

- Opportunities to take on broader leadership responsibilities as our stores, client accounts, and creative team grow.

- Performance bonuses available.

- Direct collaboration with the founder and an existing team of video editors.

- See your ideas brought to life and tested quickly.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your subject line with “GROW WITH US” so we know you read this post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



Please number your answers and include:

1. Your resume.

2. At least three examples of creative briefs you developed, and the finished ads.

3. Performance results tied to those examples, including data like date range, ad spend, and ROAS or CPA (links, screenshots, or a short description of the numbers)

4. Your years of creative strategy experience in e-commerce/DTC.

5. The brands and products you’ve worked with.

6. Your current commitments and availability.

Hey guys!



I just finished a three-day shoot for the first episode of my new YouTube series, I Could Do That, and I'm looking for a highly experienced freelance video editor to help bring this project to life.



Our goal is to create professional, cinematic, long-form YouTube content similar to Michelle Khare's Challenge Accepted series.



We're looking for someone who understands storytelling, character development, humor, tension, emotional moments, and audience retention. This is much more than simply cutting clips together.



*JOB REQUIREMENTS*



1. *DaVinci Resolve:* Must be highly proficient in DaVinci Resolve, including editing, audio, color grading, and managing large projects.



2. *Professional Long-Form Experience:* Must have significant experience editing professional YouTube documentaries, challenges, adventure content, or similar videos, typically 15–30+ minutes long.



3. *Exceptional Storytelling:* Must understand how to turn hours of raw footage into an engaging story with a compelling hook, character development, challenges, setbacks, and a satisfying conclusion.



4. *Computer Capabilities:* Must own a powerful computer capable of editing professional 4K footage and managing approximately 750 GB of source media. For one shoot (3 Days)



5. *High-Speed Internet:* Must have reliable, high-speed internet capable of transferring large amounts of video footage.



6. *Fluent English:* Must speak and understand English fluently, at least at Abanadi's level, to communicate effectively during interviews, creative discussions, and revisions.



7. *Professional Portfolio:* Must provide at least two or three examples of long-form YouTube videos they personally edited.



*MANDATORY PREPARATION BEFORE YOUR INTERVIEW*



Before interviewing, you MUST spend time studying Michelle Khare's YouTube channel, particularly her Challenge Accepted series.



Come prepared to tell me your *three favorite videos* from her channel and explain:



- Why you selected each video.

- What makes the storytelling and editing effective.

- How you would apply those same techniques to our new series, I Could Do That.

- One editing decision you would have made differently and why.



*If you have not taken the time to watch and study Michelle Khare's channel, please do not schedule an interview.*



I'm looking for someone who genuinely understands the quality and storytelling we're trying to achieve.



*POSITION DETAILS*

- Hourly compensation based on experience

- Potential for additional episodes and ongoing collaboration

- Paid editing test may be required before hiring

4. Computer specifications, including RAM, GPU, processor, and available storage

6. Your experience with DaVinci Resolve

7. A short introduction video in English explaining your professional editing experience



I'll personally interview the strongest candidates.



This is an opportunity to help build a new YouTube series from the ground up. I'm looking for someone who takes pride in their work, understands cinematic storytelling, and wants to create something exceptional.

You’ll work closely with our media buyers, editors and videographers, and with clients’ founders, to turn an offer and a customer problem into words that make people stop scrolling and take action. title: Commercial Retail Draftsperson / Architectural Technician
description:
We are looking for an experienced draftsperson or architectural technician to assist with the preparation of technical drawing packages for retail store relocations, refurbishments and new fit-outs.



This role is primarily focused on technical drafting, construction documentation and coordination, rather than interior design or concept development.



Our stores have an established design language, including existing layouts, finishes, cabinetry, signage and detailing. We will provide previous construction drawings in PDF format as a reference. However, no existing CAD files will be supplied. The successful applicant will need to recreate the drawings from scratch in CAD, using the supplied PDF documentation as the basis for the new drawing package.



Our current project involves relocating an existing store. We have an established set of drawings for the store in PDF format, which will form the basis of the new documentation. The overall design, aesthetic, finishes and cabinetry are to remain consistent with the existing store wherever possible. The task will involve reviewing the supplied PDF drawings, recreating the relevant documentation in CAD, and adapting it to suit the new tenancy dimensions and site conditions.



The project may include:

- Recreating existing floor plans and layouts in CAD.

- Adjusting layouts to suit new tenancy dimensions.

- Modifying existing cabinetry and joinery dimensions where required.

- Updating elevations, sections and construction details.

- Coordinating electrical, lighting, power, data and security layouts.

- Updating reflected ceiling plans and flooring layouts.

- Revising finishes, materials and fixture schedules where necessary.

- Preparing a complete, coordinated drawing package suitable for landlord submissions, contractor pricing and construction.



The successful applicant must be comfortable interpreting existing PDF construction drawings and independently recreating accurate, editable CAD documentation from them. The intention is to retain the original design wherever possible, making only the practical adjustments required to suit the new space.



Depending on the project, drawing packages may include:

- Existing and proposed floor plans.

- Reflected ceiling plans.

- Flooring and finishes plans.

- Internal elevations and sections.

- Custom joinery and cabinetry drawings.

- Display cabinets, counters, shelving and storage details.

- Shopfront and signage details.

- Electrical, lighting, power and data layouts.

- Security and services coordination.

- Material, fixture and finishes schedules.

- Construction details and relevant specifications.

- Drawings must be clear, accurate, properly dimensioned and coordinated across the full documentation set.



The ideal candidate's skill set:  

- Experience preparing commercial retail fit-out documentation.

- Strong technical drafting and construction detailing skills.

- Experience working with shopping centre tenancies and landlord submission requirements.

- A good understanding of Australian commercial construction practices.

- Familiarity with the National Construction Code (NCC), relevant Australian Standards and accessibility requirements.

- The ability to identify potential compliance issues and flag them for review by the relevant Australian consultants.

- Strong proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit or similar drafting software.

- Experience interpreting PDF construction drawings and recreating them as accurate CAD files.

- Experience detailing custom joinery, cabinetry and retail display fixtures.

- Excellent attention to detail and an ability to work independently.

- Experience in jewellery retail is beneficial but not essential. Experience with premium retail environments, bespoke cabinetry and detailed product displays would be highly regarded.



We are looking for someone who can:

- Work efficiently and meet agreed deadlines.

- Manage revisions and changes without unnecessary delays.

- Communicate clearly and proactively.

- Follow supplied design references and instructions accurately.

- Take ownership of their documentation and identify potential issues early.

- Work independently while remaining available for coordination and feedback.

- We are particularly interested in building an ongoing working relationship with the right person, as we anticipate further store relocations, refurbishments and new store projects.



Working Arrangement: 

- This is a remote freelance position working directly with our Australian team.



Please provide the following when applying: 

- A brief introduction and overview of your relevant experience.

- Examples of commercial retail fit-out drawing packages you have completed.

- Details of your drafting software and technical capabilities.

- Your familiarity with Australian construction standards and shopping centre submission requirements.

- Your availability and typical turnaround times.

- Your preferred fee structure (hourly rate or fixed project fee).

- Please include examples of complete construction documentation packages rather than concept designs or presentation drawings.

title: Caregiver Recruiter and Weekend Scheduling Coordinator
description:
Caregiver Recruiter and Weekend Scheduling Coordinator



Right at Home Folsom Lake | Remote • Philippines | Thursday–Monday



Right at Home Folsom Lake is a growing home care agency serving seniors and adults who need assistance at home in California. We’re looking for a dependable, organized team member to recruit caregivers, help applicants complete onboarding, and keep client shifts covered.



Recruiting and onboarding follow-up are your primary responsibilities, along with weekend scheduling and weekday backup support. You should be comfortable making calls, building relationships, and taking action when plans change.



Schedule and compensation



Thursday, Friday and Monday: 10:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m. U.S. Pacific Time.



Saturday and Sunday: 7:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. U.S. Pacific Time.



Tuesday and Wednesday off. Each shift includes a one-hour unpaid meal break, for 40 working hours per week. Call coverage during your break will be coordinated with the team.



These days and hours follow U.S. Pacific Time. Your local Philippine dates and hours will differ, and your hours will shift with U.S. daylight saving time.



Compensation: $4–$6 per hour, based on relevant experience.



Caregiver recruiting and onboarding



Review applications in Apploi, contact qualified candidates promptly, conduct initial phone screenings, and coordinate interviews with our office team.



Screen for personal-care experience, communication skills, availability, travel distance, and fit for the shifts we need covered.



Follow candidates through the offer and onboarding process. Help them understand next steps, track outstanding items, and address delays through individual calls and messages.



Coordinate follow-up on Guardian, TB documentation, iSolved onboarding, and other agency requirements. Our office team makes final hiring and readiness decisions.



Keep applicant records current and maintain a pipeline for upcoming needs. Use weekday late-afternoon and early-evening hours for interviews and follow-up.



Before signing off Monday, hand off each candidate preparing for Wednesday orientation, including missing items, next steps, and the team member responsible for follow-up.





Scheduling and weekend coverage



Own assigned weekend scheduling responsibilities during your shift and provide weekday backup support. Respond promptly to callouts, late arrivals, and open shifts.



Coordinate with our primary scheduler before the weekend to review open shifts, caregiver availability, and likely coverage needs.



Before assigning a caregiver, check skills, availability, client preferences and “do not send” restrictions, travel time, and approved scheduling limits. Obtain approval for overtime or exceptions.



Update WellSky and confirm changes with caregivers and clients or points of contact, following our communication procedures.



Escalate urgent or unresolved coverage issues promptly. Document your actions and provide a clear handoff of open shifts, pending responses, and next steps before your shift ends.



Urgent client coverage takes priority over routine recruiting. Follow through until the issue is resolved or the designated team member has accepted the handoff. This position covers the scheduled hours above; it is not a 24/7 on-call role.



What we are looking for



U.S. home care recruiting experience strongly preferred, with scheduling experience and confidence handling time-sensitive situations.



Clear spoken and written English, strong attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.



Ability to work independently, make frequent outbound calls, and keep the team informed.



Experience with WellSky/ClearCare, Apploi, and Microsoft 365 is a plus; comfort learning new software, including AI-assisted tools.



Reliable computer, headset, internet connection, backup connectivity and power plan, and a quiet workspace.



Ability to handle confidential applicant, caregiver, and client information appropriately.



How we measure success



We review onboarding completion, orientation attendance, first shifts worked, and 30-day caregiver activity, alongside timely scheduling follow-up and accurate handoffs. We also review scheduling workload so recruiting receives the attention it needs.



How to apply



Use “Recruiter + Scheduler – [Your Name]” as your application subject and include:



Your résumé, a brief summary of your U.S. home care recruiting and scheduling experience, and the systems you have used.



Your expected hourly rate, earliest start date, and confirmation that you can work the exact schedule above.



A short introductory video and your written response to this scenario:



“A caregiver calls out two hours before a Saturday shift. The client cannot safely be left without care, and the first three caregivers you contact are unavailable. What do you do next, who do you notify, and what do you document?”

title: FP&A Reporting
description:
SCOPE OF SERVICES

Purpose

Lake City Plating LLC is requesting quotes from qualified independent contractors to provide remote FP&A, financial reporting, and data analysis services on a part-time basis. This is a solicitation for professional services, not a job posting or offer of employment.



Requested Services and Deliverables

• Prepare month-end financial reporting and variance analysis, including budget, forecast, prior-year, and period-over-period comparisons with concise explanations of material drivers.

• Analyze inventory, purchasing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, cash flow, and working capital trends; identify risks, exceptions, and operational or financial impacts.

• Build and improve financial statement dashboards, support schedules, and repeatable reporting processes using Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Excel, Power Query, and Power BI.

• Generate recurring and ad hoc financial reports and perform special projects involving profitability, margins, costs, cash flow, forecasting, data cleanup, process improvement, or management decision support.

• Reconcile reports and dashboards to the general ledger and financial statements; document data sources, account mappings, assumptions, calculations, refresh steps, exceptions, and review controls.

• Provide clear conclusions, key drivers, unresolved issues, and recommended next actions, along with editable workpapers, dashboards, models, queries, and process documentation.

Systems, Security, and Work Standards

• Work will be performed remotely using secure, company-approved access and collaboration methods.

• Company data may not be stored in personal cloud storage, shared with unauthorized parties, or entered into unapproved artificial intelligence or external processing tools.

• Deliverables must be accurate, maintainable by company personnel, supported by clear audit trails, and free of undocumented manual steps or black-box calculations.

• The contractor must follow company confidentiality, data-security, document-retention, and access-control requirements and promptly report suspected unauthorized access or data loss.

Contractor Qualifications

• Demonstrated FP&A, accounting, financial reporting, or data analysis experience, preferably in manufacturing, inventory, purchasing, or multi-site operations.

• Strong knowledge of financial statements, month-end reporting, variance analysis, working capital, inventory, purchasing, and management reporting.

• Advanced Excel and Power Query skills; experience with Power BI and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is preferred.

• Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain financial results clearly and professionally to management.

• Ability to work independently, identify incomplete or inconsistent data, meet agreed deadlines, and maintain confidential financial information.



Quote Requirements

• Contractor name, contact information, location, and summary of relevant experience.

• Proposed pricing, including hourly rate, retainer or project fees, minimum billing increments, expenses, invoice frequency, and payment terms.

• Estimated monthly capacity, availability during month-end close, anticipated response time, and proposed approach to reporting, quality review, documentation, and data security.

• Assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, required access or software, proposed subcontractor use, and potential conflicts of interest.

• Two professional references or representative project examples and the period for which the quote remains valid.

Independent Contractor and Commercial Terms

• The engagement will be governed by a written independent contractor agreement, confidentiality and security requirements, and approved statements of work or written project authorizations.

• The contractor will control the manner and means of performing the services, subject to agreed deliverables, deadlines, quality standards, security requirements, and authorized system access.

• The contractor is responsible for applicable taxes, insurance, licenses, tools, and business expenses and is not eligible for employee wages, overtime, benefits, paid time off, or other employee programs.

• Use of subcontractors requires prior written approval. Company-specific deliverables, data, models, documentation, and other work product will be handled as stated in the final agreement.

• This RFQ does not obligate Lake City Plating LLC to award work, reimburse proposal costs, or accept any quote. Scope, pricing, timing, ownership, and final terms remain subject to written agreement.

Evaluation and Submission

Quotes will be evaluated based on relevant experience, technical capability, communication, security practices, availability, proposed approach, and overall value. Submit the quote and supporting information to the company contact identified in the RFQ communication. Work may begin only after the applicable agreement is signed and written authorization is provided.

Company Notice

Lake City Plating LLC reserves the right to accept or reject any quote, request clarification, negotiate scope or pricing, discontinue the RFQ process, or engage more than one service provider. Information provided during the RFQ process must be treated as confidential and used only to prepare the quote.

title: **Cold Caller + Social Media + Lead Research for a US Chimney & Masonry Company ($5 to $8/hr + 5% Commission)**
description:
**Cold Caller + Social Media + Lead Research for a US Chimney & Masonry Company ($5 to $8/hr + 5% Commission)**





We're Crown & Ash, a chimney sweep and masonry company in Detroit, Michigan. We do sweeps, chimney repairs, tuckpointing, and brick and stone work for homeowners and commercial buildings like churches, apartment buildings, and restaurants.



I'm looking for one person to own my lead pipeline and my social media. You find the leads, call them, book appointments on my calendar, and keep our online presence active. I handle the estimates and the work. You fill my schedule.



**What you'll do**



*Leads and calling*

- Build call lists from public property records, focusing on recently sold older homes. New owners usually haven't had the chimney checked, and they want to use the fireplace.

- Build commercial lists of churches, property managers, HOAs, apartment buildings, and restaurants with wood-fired ovens.

- Call homeowners and businesses to book chimney inspections and estimates.

- Follow up on quotes that haven't been signed yet.

- Reach out to real estate agents, home inspectors, HVAC companies, and roofers who can refer jobs to us.

- Keep every lead, call, and outcome logged in the CRM.

- Check government bid websites once a week for masonry and chimney jobs.



*Social media*

- Run our
, Instagram, and Google Business Profile.

- Turn my job photos and phone videos into before and after posts and short reels.

- Post on Google Business Profile weekly and ask every finished customer for a review.

- Answer comments and messages the same day, and book anyone interested.

- Keep a simple monthly content calendar built around the seasons.



**What you need**

- At least 1 year of outbound calling to US customers. Home services, roofing, or real estate is a big plus.

- Clear, confident English on the phone.

- Comfortable with Google Sheets, a CRM, Canva, and a simple video editor like CapCut.

- A quiet workspace, a good headset, and backup internet.

- Able to work US Eastern hours, mostly afternoons and early evenings, when homeowners pick up.



**Minimum expectations**

- At least 3 booked estimates per week.

- At least 3 social media posts per week.



If you fall below these two weeks in a row, we'll sit down and talk about it. If it keeps happening, it's not the right fit.



**Pay**

- 25 to 30 hours a week to start.

- Starting rate is $5/hr.

- **Raises are based on closed jobs you bring in.** Every month I'll review the paid jobs that came from your leads:



| Your leads bring in (paid jobs per month) | Your hourly rate |

|---|---|

| Starting rate | $5/hr |

| $8,000 | $6/hr |

| $18,000 | $7/hr |

| $30,000 and up | $8/hr (max rate) |



- You move up one step each month you hit the next level. Once you reach a rate, you keep it as long as you're meeting the minimum expectations.

- **5% commission on every job you bring in that closes and gets paid,** on top of your hourly rate. There's no cap on commission. If your leads bring in $18,000 in a month, that's $900 extra plus your raise.

- Commission is paid the month after the customer pays in full. A lead counts as yours if you found or booked it and logged it in the CRM under your name before I quote it.

- Full-time hours are open for the right person once the pipeline is running.



**How to apply (read carefully)**

1. Start your application with the word "Crown" and the city you live in. Applications that don't will not be read.

2. Send a 3 to 5 minute video, a Loom link is fine. In the video:

   - **Tell me about yourself and your background.** Where you've worked, what kind of calling and social media work you've done, and for what type of businesses.

   - **Tell me what you bring to the table.** What would you do in your first 30 days to get me more booked jobs? Be specific.

   - **Do a practice call.** Pretend you're calling a homeowner who just bought a house built in 1945, and book them for a chimney inspection.

3. Send 2 or 3 examples of social media posts or reels you've made for a business.

4. Tell me how many calls a day you made in your last calling job, and what dialer and CRM you used.

5. Attach a screenshot of your internet speed test.



No video, no review. If your answers sound like they came from ChatGPT, I'll skip them. I want to see and hear you, not a robot. Shortlisted applicants will do a short paid test before hiring.

title: B2B & Ecommerce Order Fulfillment Specialist
description:
OPERATIONS COORDINATOR

B2B Sales & Fulfillment, Customer Experience, Listings & Systems

Full-time | Remote (overlaps US business hours) | Reports to Lisa Hu, Founder & CEO





ABOUT LUX & NYX



Lux & Nyx designs architectural handbags for professional women who refuse to choose between style and function. Featured in Forbes, Refinery29, NPR, and Marie Claire. We sell across Shopify DTC, Amazon, Nordstrom, and Macy's, and through a corporate gifting channel served by promotional-products distributors. Remote-first team led by founder Lisa Hu. We move fast. We build systems that compound. We hire people who can think and ship.





THE ROLE



You'll own our corporate gifting business from the first
 to the day the order lands. Nearly every inquiry comes from a promotional-products distributor who is pitching Lux & Nyx to their client. You answer them the same day, send quotes they can trust, and follow every open quote until it becomes a yes or a no. When it becomes a yes, you plan the order backward from the date it has to arrive: artwork, decoration, kitting, cartons, labels, and shipping, with every party lined up in time. You'll also look after our direct-to-consumer customers, keep our marketplace listings and systems current, and take on new system updates as the business grows.



This role is half conversation and half precision. You need to be warm and confident with a buyer, and you need to refuse to send anything when a number doesn't add up. The most valuable thing you do is tell a distributor exactly what it takes to hit their date, before anyone promises it.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



1. Inquiries & quotes: answer distributor and corporate inquiries the same business day. Quote price, minimums, colorways, decoration options, and lead times accurately, and check stock and the timeline before you commit to any date.



2. Quote follow-up: keep every open quote in our pipeline tracker with a next step and the client's event date. Quotes often stay open for months, so you check in with each distributor on a steady cadence and time your follow-ups to their client's deadline, so nothing goes quiet without a decision.



3. Order entry & confirmation: when a quote becomes an order, re-check stock, pricing, and timing before you confirm. Log every PO clean, and make sure the PO, the quote, and the confirmation all match before anything goes out.



4. Backward planning: for every dated order, build the timeline back from the in-hand date: when art must be approved, when the designer and decorator must start, when the warehouse kits and ships. Then make sure each person gets what they need on time.



5. Pack-out & shipping: work out cartons and shipping labels from our pack-out spec (a partial carton is still a carton), confirm counts with the warehouse before labels are made, and run a final check before anything ships. If a number isn't on file, you go get it. You never estimate it.



6. DTC customer experience: answer customer
s and messages from our own site and social within 24 hours, warmly and in our brand voice: order questions, product questions, and warranty and return requests, handled by our policies and followed through to resolution.



7. Marketplace & catalog listings: manage our product listings on Amazon, Nordstrom, and our Mirakl-based retailer marketplaces, plus B2B supplier catalogs (such as ESP, SAGE, and distributor and rewards platforms). That means day-to-day product data entry and updates (images, pricing, specs) whenever a product, price, or color changes, checked against our master sheet and followed through until each listing is live and correct. Larger batch uploads are handled with a marketplace specialist.



8. Systems, updates & SOPs: keep one source of truth for quotes, orders, and product data, take on other system and data updates across our platforms as they come up, and write down every step so the process never lives in one person's head.



9. AI & tooling (evolving): use AI to speed up drafting and repetitive steps where it helps, and help shape what's worth automating.



Not part of this role: Amazon and retail-marketplace customer service (another teammate owns that), and cold outbound prospecting (our founder and sales consultant own that).





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



1. You stop rather than send. If a price, date, or count doesn't reconcile, nothing goes out until it does. That's the #1 thing.

2. You plan backward from the deadline. Give you an in-hand date and you can tell us the date every step has to start, and who needs to hear about it first.

3. 3+ years in B2B order management: promotional products, corporate gifting, wholesale, or similar, with orders that run for weeks across several outside parties (vendors, decorators, warehouses, carriers).

4. Clear, polished English, written and spoken. You can hold a buyer conversation on your own, quote with confidence, and say "here's what it takes" instead of an easy yes. With our direct customers, you're warm, quick, and on-brand.

5. Organized follow-through on a pipeline: dozens of open quotes at once, each with a next step, none forgotten.

6. A builder. When something was never written down, you write it down, get it checked, and make it the standard.

7. Comfortable with product data entry and uploads from spreadsheet templates, with zero tolerance for a wrong price or spec going live. We'll train you on our marketplace SOPs. Amazon Seller Central, retailer-portal (Nordstrom, Mirakl), or supplier-catalog (ESP, SAGE) experience is a plus.

8. Comfortable with the tools: Shopify, spreadsheets with formulas, a CRM or pipeline tracker, and AI for drafting.

9. Calm and steady in async, remote, founder-led work, with meaningful overlap with US business hours.

10. Here for the long haul: someone who wants to own this work and get great at it, not use it as a stepping stone.





WHAT SEPARATES GREAT FROM GOOD



1. Tells a distributor "here's what it takes to hit your date" instead of just yes or no.

2. Notices the number that's missing, and goes and gets it instead of guessing.

3. Briefs the designer at the start of the order, not the end.

4. Follows up because a deadline is coming, not just because time has passed.

5. Documents as they go, so nothing lives in one person's head.

6. Steady when gifting season hits.





HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



Targets calibrate quarterly. These are the outcomes you'll actually be measured on:



- Inquiry response: same business day

- DTC customer response: every inquiry answered in under 24h; nothing dropped

- Quote accuracy: zero quotes sent with a wrong price, minimum, or lead time

- Quote follow-through: every open quote tracked with a next step; none goes quiet without a decision

- On-time delivery: every B2B order arrives by its in-hand date

- Order & shipment accuracy: zero incomplete shipments; cartons = labels = packing list

- Listing accuracy: zero live errors (price / spec / image) on Amazon, retailer portals, and B2B catalogs

- Pre-send checks: zero documents released with a number that doesn't reconcile

- SOP coverage: every recurring step documented





HOW WE WORK TOGETHER



1. Weekly 1:1 with Lisa (founder & CEO): priorities, open quotes, what's shipping, and what's at risk.

2. Day-to-day coordination with Michelle (operations) and our warehouse team on fulfillment.

3. Quarterly planning: themes, major moments (holiday, gifting season), and KPI targets.

4. Async-first via Slack: decisions documented, same-day response on blockers.





COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



Competitive compensation tied to experience and location. Paid PTO. Health stipend. Remote-first culture with intentional async work.





HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word CLEAN, and in three sentences tell us about an order with a hard deadline that you planned backward from: what had to happen when, and who you had to line up. Then attach your resume. Applications that skip either step won't be read.



That one line is deliberate: it's how we see, before we ever meet, whether you read carefully and whether you own the details instead of waiting for someone to catch them for you.





OUR HIRING PROCESS



We keep it simple and respect your time:

1. Apply: the word CLEAN, three sentences, and your resume.

2. If shortlisted: a short recorded answer (3–5 minutes) to a few questions we send you.

3. If invited: a paid skills test based on real work ($30, about 4 hours, paid regardless of outcome).

4. Final steps: an interview with our founder and reference check.



We reply to every shortlisted applicant and aim to make a decision within 3 weeks.





ABOUT THE TEAM



We're a remote-first team. We run on weekly syncs, regular 1:1s, and quarterly goal-setting. We lead before we're asked. We think from the customer's perspective. We grow with intention. We think deeply before we act. If that's how you work too, we'd love to meet you.

title: VA FOR AMAZON
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Virtual Assistant to help with Amazon product sourcing, wholesale research, and supplier discovery.



The ideal candidate will help identify profitable products to sell on Amazon, research potential brands and distributors, review wholesale catalogs, and build a database of suppliers and purchasing opportunities.



We are looking for someone who can independently research opportunities, think critically, and consistently bring forward new products and suppliers for our business.



### Key Responsibilities



**1. Amazon Product Research & Sourcing**

- Research potential wholesale products to sell on Amazon.

- Identify products with strong sales potential, demand, and healthy profit margins.

- Analyze Amazon listings, competition, sales estimates, pricing, and number of sellers.

- Use tools such as Keepa, SellerAmp SAS, Helium 10, or similar product research software.

- Identify products with manageable competition and opportunities for wholesale resale.

- Analyze product variations, sales history, Buy Box pricing, and seller competition.



**2. Wholesale Catalog Research**

- Review wholesale catalogs, price lists, and supplier spreadsheets.

- Identify products that are already selling well on Amazon.

- Compare wholesale costs against current Amazon selling prices.

- Calculate estimated Amazon fees, profit margins, ROI, and potential profitability.

- Organize promising products into spreadsheets for review.



**3. Brand & Distributor Research**

- Find brands offering wholesale accounts or authorized distributor programs.

- Identify distributors, importers, and wholesalers that supply products suitable for Amazon resale.

- Research brands with limited competition or opportunities in the Canadian and US Amazon marketplaces.

- Find supplier contact information, including purchasing managers, sales representatives, and wholesale departments.

- Identify potential brands and distributors we can contact to establish wholesale relationships.



**4. Supplier Outreach & Lead Generation**

- Compile lists of potential brands, wholesalers, and distributors.

- Prepare professional outreach
s using provided templates.

- Follow up with suppliers when required.

- Track responses, wholesale account applications, catalogs, and pricing information.

- Maintain an organized database of supplier contacts and opportunities.



### Requirements

- Previous experience with Amazon FBA wholesale or online arbitrage research is preferred.

- Knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and Amazon product research.

- Experience using Keepa, SellerAmp, Helium 10, or similar tools.

- Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills.

- Ability to research brands, manufacturers, importers, and distributors.

- Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.

- Good written English and professional communication.

- Ability to work independently and meet weekly targets.



### Preferred Qualifications

- Experience sourcing products for Amazon Canada and Amazon USA.

- Experience reviewing wholesale catalogs and supplier price lists.

- Understanding of Amazon FBA fees, ROI, profit margins, and sales estimates.

- Experience finding authorized wholesalers and establishing supplier relationships.



### Expected Deliverables



We expect consistent weekly results, including:



- A list of researched Amazon wholesale product opportunities.

- An organized spreadsheet of profitable products identified from supplier catalogs.

- A list of new brands, distributors, and wholesalers to contact.

- Supplier contact information and outreach tracking.

- Product profitability analysis, including estimated fees, ROI, and margins.



### How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Describe your previous experience with Amazon wholesale sourcing.

2. What product research tools have you used?

3. Have you worked with wholesale catalogs or distributor price lists before?

4. Provide an example of a product you have sourced or researched for Amazon.

5. Explain how you evaluate whether a product is worth selling on Amazon.



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship as our sourcing operations grow.

title: YouTube Video Editor | Storytelling, Lifestyle & Cinematic Vlogs
description:
Creative YouTube Video Editor (Long-Term Opportunity)



I'm a lifestyle and home content creator looking for an exceptionally talented YouTube video editor to help bring my creative vision to life.



I'm not looking for someone who simply cuts clips together, adds transitions, and calls it a day. I'm looking for someone who genuinely **understands YouTube, loves storytelling, has incredible attention to detail, and knows how to make ordinary moments feel interesting and beautiful.**



This is an opportunity to grow alongside a creator and help build a YouTube channel from the ground up, with the potential for a long-term working relationship.



### The Creative Style



Please familiarize yourself with these YouTube creators before applying:



- Victoria Morse

- Alex Nicoll



I'm drawn to their thoughtful storytelling, beautiful visuals, natural pacing, personality, and ability to make everyday life engaging.



My content will focus on cozy minimalist living, home, lifestyle, routines, organization, creativity, and personal experiences.



The goal is to create videos that feel cinematic yet authentic, aesthetically beautiful without being overproduced, and personal without feeling forced.



### What I'm Looking For



**You MUST have previous experience editing long-form YouTube videos.**



Ideally, you're someone who:



- Understands storytelling, narrative structure, pacing, and audience retention.

- Knows how to create compelling openings that make viewers want to keep watching.

- Has an excellent eye for color grading, natural lighting, composition, and visual consistency.

- Can create smooth, intentional edits without relying on excessive transitions or effects.

- Understands music selection, sound design, ambient audio, and how sound contributes to emotion.

- Can identify the strongest moments in raw footage and build a cohesive story around them.

- Understands YouTube culture, current editing styles, and what makes videos successful.

- Can incorporate tasteful typography, subtle graphics, B-roll, and creative transitions when appropriate.

- Understands the difference between TikTok editing and long-form YouTube storytelling.

- Is comfortable editing lifestyle, home, vlog, and personality-driven content.

- Has a strong creative perspective and isn't afraid to suggest improvements.

- Has excellent attention to detail and can maintain consistency across videos.

- Is fluent in written and spoken English and can confidently understand conversational American English, humor, and cultural references.

- Is dependable, organized, communicative, and receptive to feedback.



**Most importantly, I want someone who goes the extra mile.**



Someone who notices when a scene could use better sound design, when an introduction isn't compelling enough, or when changing the sequence of clips could make the story significantly stronger.



I want a creative collaborator, not just someone following instructions.



### Your Responsibilities



- Edit engaging, polished long-form YouTube videos.

- Review raw footage and identify the strongest story.

- Develop compelling hooks, thoughtful pacing, and satisfying endings.

- Perform professional color correction and color grading.

- Source appropriate licensed or royalty-free music and sound effects.

- Incorporate tasteful B-roll, text, graphics, and transitions.

- Ensure consistent audio levels and polished sound.

- Make creative suggestions to improve storytelling and viewer retention.

- Deliver organized files and completed videos on schedule.

- Collaborate on revisions and continuously improve the editing style.



Bonus if you understand YouTube analytics, audience retention graphs, thumbnail strategy, and how editing decisions impact watch time.



### Software & Experience



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro is welcome.



I'm much more interested in your storytelling ability, editing taste, and past work than the specific software you use.



### How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. **Your portfolio:** Share 2 to 3 long-form YouTube videos you've personally edited. Clearly explain your role in each project.

2. **Your YouTube taste:** Who are your 3 favorite YouTube creators to watch, and what do you appreciate about their editing or storytelling?

3. **Your creative perspective:** Watch content from Victoria Morse, Alex Nicoll, or Alisson Baek. Tell me what you notice about their editing style and how you would approach creating something with a similar feeling while developing an original identity for my channel.

4. **Your storytelling process:** How do you turn raw footage without a script into an engaging YouTube video?

5. **Your experience:** How many years have you been editing YouTube videos, and which editing software do you use?

6. **Your availability and rate:** Please share your current availability, expected compensation, and typical turnaround time for a 25-30+ minute YouTube video.



Please begin your application with the words **"Sunday Storyteller"** so I know you've read the full description.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid editing test.



### The Opportunity



I'm looking for someone I can build a lasting creative partnership with.



As the channel grows, I'd love for this person to become increasingly involved in shaping its visual identity, storytelling approach, and overall creative direction.



If you genuinely love YouTube, have exceptional creative instincts, and take pride in making every video better than expected, I'd love to see your work.
